units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 3 канон токмо един трипеснец в понеделник и
units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3. Канѡ́нъ то́кмо є҆ди́нъ, Трипѣ́снецъ въ Понедѣ́лникъ и҆ Сре́дꙋ, и҆лѝ Двопѣ́снецъ, ко Вто́рникѣ; Тропа́рїе на в҃і, І҆рмосѝ же по в҃-жды. Пѣ́сней не глаго́лемъ, но Припѣ́въ до Тропаре́й Канѡ́на: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, Сла́ва тебѣ̀³), та́же Катавасі́а, І҆рмо́съ Канѡ́на а҃-жды, ѻ҆́ба Ли́ка вкꙋ́пѣ. Пре́жде Конд-І҆́коса глаго́летъ І҆ере́й Є҆кте́нїꙋ ма́лꙋю; на ѳ҃-й Пѣ́сни Честнѣ́йшꙋю не пое́мъ, нижѐ Досто́йна по Канѡ́нѣ, но по Катавасі́и а҆́бїе Є҆кте́нїꙋ ма́лꙋю, и҆ Свѣти́ленъ Черто́гъ тво́й в҃-жды, та́же Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ трети́цею то́йже.
units.english_cohort_translation: 3. Only one Canon: a Three-Ode Canon on Monday and Wednesday, or a Two-Ode Canon on Tuesday; Troparia for 12, Heirmoi twice. We do not say the Biblical Odes, but the refrain to the Troparia of the Canon: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Сла́ва Тебѣ̀, Бо́же на́шъ, сла́ва Тебѣ̀*);[^576] then the Katavasia: the Heirmos of the Canon once, both Choirs together. Before the Kontakion and Ikos the Priest says the Little Ektenia; at the 9th Ode we do not sing **"More honorable"** (*Честнѣ́йшꙋю*), nor **"It is truly right"** (*Досто́йно*) after the Canon, but after the Katavasia immediately the Little Ektenia, and the Exaposteilarion **"Thy bridal chamber"** (*Черто́гъ тво́й*) twice, then **"Glory... Both now..."**, the same a third time.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ²) Спасѝ Бж҃е Гре́честїи Оу҆ста́ви не помина́ютъ; помина́ютъ же, О҆́ко Це́рк. а҆ за ни́мъ Трїѡ́ди на́ша и҆ Россі́йскїѧ.
units.english_cohort_translation: 2. Directly after the Theotokion **"Theotokos, thou art the true vine"** (*Богоро́дице, ты̀ е҆сѝ лоза̀*) at the 3rd Hour, and after the corresponding Theotokia at the other two Hours, the Typika appoint the Reading of the Four Gospels (*Tetraevangélion*), which among us today is read only in Cathedral or Collegiate Churches;[^577] at the 6th Hour, however, we read the Gospel not immediately after the Theotokion, but after the conclusion of the Troparion of the Prophecy and the Prokeimena of the Paremia. The Reading of the Four Gospels embraces all Evangelists, that is, Matthew, Mark, and Luke whole, but John only up to the Passions of Christ, that is, up to: **"Now is the Son of man glorified"** (*Ны́нѣ просла́висѧ*), in Pericope 46, Chapter 13:32 [13:31]. All the Evangelists taken together are divided into 9 Readings, according to the number of the three Hours (3rd, 6th, 9th) and three days (Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday). Matthew is divided into 2 Readings, and Mark into 2, and John into 2, but Luke into 3. The 1st Reading embraces the first half of Matthew, the 2nd the second half of Matthew, the 3rd the first half of Mark, the 4th the second half of Mark, the 5th the first part of Luke, the 6th the second part of Luke, the 7th the third part of Luke; the 8th the first part of John, the 9th the second part of John. And the Typikon indeed does not determine where the first half of the three Evangelists and the first and second parts of Luke conclude; but since Matthew has 28 chapters, his half concludes with Chapter 14; Mark has 16 chapters, so his half concludes with Chapter 8; Luke has 24 chapters, so his first part concludes with Chapter 8, and the second with Chapter 16; John up to **"Now is the Son of man glorified"** has 12 chapters and part of Chapter 13, so his half concludes with Chapter 6 and part of 7.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆ере́й къ нача́лѣ коегѡ́ждо Чте́нїа ѻ҆блаче́нъ въ Фелѡ́нъ по́стныхъ ша́рѡвъ, и҆ ѿве́рзъ Ст҃ы̑ѧ Две́ри, кади́тъ всѧ̑ по ѻ҆бы́чаю, та́же и҆зше́дъ Ст҃ы́ми Две́рми къ А҆нало́гїю поста́вленомꙋ предъ Ст҃ы́ми Две́рми проти́въ ---------------- ¹) Въ но́вѣмъ Тѵпі́кѣ Патрїархі́а Царьгра́д. нижѐ помина́етсѧ.
units.english_cohort_translation: The Priest, at the beginning of each Reading, vested in a phelonion of fasting colors, and having opened the Holy Doors, censes all things according to custom, then having gone out through the Holy Doors to the Analogion placed before the Holy Doors facing the people, having upon it two burning candlesticks, reads from there the Gospel, beginning from **"And that we may be accounted worthy..."** (*И҆ ѡ҆ є҆́же сподо́битися на́мъ*). Upon completing each Reading, having kissed the beginning of the reading and left the Gospel on the Analogion until the completion of the 3rd Reading, he returns to the Sanctuary, and having closed the Holy Doors, divests himself of the phelonion.[^578]

О҆ба́че сїѧ̀ сꙋ́ть прибавле́нїа и҆зли́шнаѧ Греко-Славѧ́нѡвъ, Гре́кѡмъ невѣ́дома; є҆два̀ моли́тва Влады́ко многоми́лостиве мо́жетъ задержа́тисѧ, и҆ Проще́нїа въ Монастырѣ́хъ; Помина́нїа же здѣ̀ и҆зли́шна сꙋ́ть, во́змꙋтсѧ бо по́слѣ при концѝ Повече́рїѧ и҆ ПолꙊ́нощници, не и҆мꙋ́щаѧ свѧ́зи съ Проще́нїи за грѣхѝ м҃-ци.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: вся по оуставу понед и вторн зде на
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Всѧ̑ по Оу҆ста́вꙋ Понед. и҆ Вто́рн. здѣ̀ на стр. 573; то́кмо въ Сре́дꙋ по Ѿпꙋще́нїи Лїтꙋргі́и Прежде- ---------------- ¹) Трїѡ́дь Поча́евск. 1786 и҆́мать си́це: „И҆ а҆́бїе оу҆краше́нꙋ А҆нало́гїю, положа́тъ на не́мъ верхꙋ̀ ст҃о́е Четвероеѵⷢ҇лїе, двѣма̀ лампа́дома возже́ннома. Всѣ̑мъ же стоѧ́щимъ ѿкрове́нными глава́ми, Сщ҃е́нникъ же кади́тъ Хра́мъ ве́сь, и҆ Бра́тїю: а҆ на ѕ҃-мъ Часѣ̀ кади́тъ то́кмо Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе; на ѳ҃-мъ же Часѣ̀ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе кади́тъ, и҆ Хра́мъ ве́сь, и҆ Бра́тїю, и҆ та́кѡ чте́тъ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе.“ Тѵпі́ци Россі́йстїн: „Кади́тъ І҆ере́й ѻ҆́крестъ А҆нало́гїа, и҆ О҆лта́рь, и҆ Це́рковь всю̀, и҆ Бра́тїю по чи́нꙋ.“ Трїѡ́дь Гре́ч. молчи́тъ ѡ҆ си́хъ всѣ́хъ, и҆ глаго́летъ то́кмо: Ἀναγινώσκεται δὲ καὶ τὸ Τετραευαγγέλιον τῇ Βʹ, τῇ Γʹ, καὶ τῇ Δʹ, καὶ πληροῦται.
units.english_cohort_translation: **On Wednesday at Vespers with the Presanctified, at Compline, and at Midnight Office** All according to the Typikon of Monday and Tuesday, here on p. 573 [428]; only on Wednesday after the dismissal of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Presanctified, "the prostrations made in church cease, but in cells they are performed even until the bell for Matins of Christ's Bright Resurrection."[^579] We, however, even until the Resurrection of Christ make 3 great prostrations in church at the end of the divine service, singing the stichon **"Thou Who hast suffered..."** (*Претерпѣ́вый за на́съ*), and at the veneration of the Plashchanytsia, singing **"The noble Joseph"** (*Благообра́зный І҆ѡ́сифъ*).

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 2 вместо бг гд поем аллилуиа во глас
units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2. Вмѣ́стѡ Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь пое́мъ А҆ллилꙋ́їа во Гла́съ и҃, си́рѣчь на Гла́съ слѣ́дꙋющагѡ Тропарѧ̀; но поне́же Тропа́рь се́й и҆́мать ѻ҆со́бенный напѣ́въ въ І҆рмоло́гїи, сегѡ̀ ра́ди и҆ А҆ллилꙋ́їа пое́мъ по ѻ҆́бразꙋ напѣ́ва сегѡ̀.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 5 канон токмо един ирмос по в жды тропарие
units.slavonic_diplomatic: 5. Канѡ́нъ то́кмо є҆ди́нъ: І҆рмосѝ по в҃-жды, Тропа́рїе же на ѕ҃¹), съ Припѣ́вомъ, Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шь, Сла́ва тебѣ̀. Катавасі́а по ко́ейждо Пѣ́сни І҆рмо́съ тогѡ́же Канѡ́на а҃-жды, ѻ҆́ба Ли́ка вкꙋ́пѣ. По г҃-й Пѣ́сни глаго́лемъ Сѣда́ленъ, по ѕ҃-й Конд-І҆́косъ, на ѳ҃-й Честнѣ́йшꙋ не пое́мъ²), нижѐ по ѳ҃-й Досто́йна, но вмѣ́стѡ негѡ̀ І҆рмо́съ Канѡ́на³), и҆ а҆́бїе Свѣти́ленъ в҃-жды, Сла́ва, И҆ ны́нѣ то́йже.
units.english_cohort_translation: 5. Only one Canon: Heirmoi twice, Troparia for 6,[^582] with the refrain: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Сла́ва Тебѣ̀, Бо́же на́шъ, сла́ва Тебѣ̀*). Katavasia after each Ode: the Heirmos of the same Canon once, both Choirs together. After the 3rd Ode we say the Sessional Hymn; after the 6th, the Kontakion and Ikos; at the 9th we do not sing **"More honorable"** (*Честнѣ́йшꙋю*),[^583] nor **"It is truly right"** (*Досто́йно*) after the 9th, but instead of it the Heirmos of the Canon;[^584] and immediately the Exaposteilarion twice; **"Glory... Both now..."**, the same.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: подобает иерееви в четверток великий на литургии два
units.slavonic_diplomatic: „Подоба́етъ (І҆ере́еви) въ Четверто́къ вели́кїй на Лїтꙋргі́и два̀ А҆́гнца ѡ҆ст҃и́ти, и҆ є҆ди́нъ оу҆́бо въ Причаще́нїи оу҆потребля́ти, дрꙋгі́й же въ Кївѡ́тъ вложи́ти, и҆ въ Скині́и на ѻ҆бы́чномъ мѣ́стѣ да́же до дне́сь (до Пѧтка̀) храни́ти“. Си́це и҆́мать на́шъ Слꙋже́бникъ³). Каса́тельнѡ же самогѡ̀ А҆́гнца, и҆мꙋ́щагѡ храни́тисѧ въ Скині́и да́же до днѐ выставле́нїа, повелѣва́етъ Собо́ръ Львѡ́вскїй, да́бы ѻ҆́нъ пре́жде ѡ҆сщ҃е́нїа примѣ́реный бы́лъ до своегѡ̀ сосꙋ́дца, си́це глаго́лемагѡ Мелхїседе́ка, въ то́еже до́брѣ вста́вленый, и҆ сохра́ннѡ ѡ҆кте́ртый, ꙗ҆́коже бы по́слѣ не спа́дати съ негѡ̀ крꙋпи́цамъ; и҆ да́бы си́це заложе́ный въ Мелхїседе́цѣ, ѡ҆свѧще́ный бы́лъ на Лїтꙋргі́и въ нѣ́коемъ ѿ пред̾идꙋ́щихъ дне́й, и҆ та́кѡ ѡ҆сщ҃е́нъ храни́лсѧ въ Кївѡ́тѣ даже до самогѡ̀ выставле́нїа.“³) Є҆гда̀ же І҆ере́й предꙋготовля́етъ на Проскоми́дїи А҆́гнца хотя́щаго оу҆потреби́тисѧ на выставле́нїи, не и҆́мать глаго́лати надъ не́мъ Словеса̀: Во воспомина́нїе Гдⷭ҇а, и҆ прѡ́ч. нижѐ твори́ти на не́мъ дѣ́йствїа ꙗ҆́же ѻ҆бы́чнѡ тво́рѧтсѧ на ---------------- ¹) О҆́ко Це́рк.
units.english_cohort_translation: "The Priest ought on Great Thursday at the Liturgy to consecrate two Lambs, and to consume one in Communion, but to place the other in the Pyx (Ciborium), and to keep it in the Tabernacle in the usual place even unto today (unto Friday)." Thus our Sluzhebnik has it. Concerning the Lamb itself that is to be kept in the Tabernacle until the day of exposition, the Synod of Lviv commands: "that it, before consecration, be fitted to its vessel, the so-called Melchizedek, properly placed therein, and carefully wiped, so that particles might not afterwards fall from it; and that having been thus enclosed in the Melchizedek, it be consecrated at the Liturgy on one of the preceding days, and thus consecrated be kept in the Pyx even unto the exposition itself."[^588] When the Priest prepares at the Proskomide the Lamb that is to be used for the exposition, he is not to say over it the words: **"In remembrance of our Lord..."**, etc., nor perform upon it the actions that are usually performed upon the Lamb that is to be consumed at that same Liturgy, for it is deemed to be only for the Communicants; it suffices to trim it for its easier fracturing and consumption on another day.

Каса́тельнѡ же самогѡ̀ А҆́гнца, и҆мꙋ́щагѡ храни́тисѧ въ Скині́и да́же до днѐ выставле́нїа, повелѣва́етъ Собо́ръ Львѡ́вскїй, да́бы ѻ҆́нъ пре́жде ѡ҆сщ҃е́нїа примѣ́реный бы́лъ до своегѡ̀ сосꙋ́дца, си́це глаго́лемагѡ Мелхїседе́ка, въ то́еже до́брѣ вста́вленый, и҆ сохра́ннѡ ѡ҆кте́ртый, ꙗ҆́коже бы по́слѣ не спа́дати съ негѡ̀ крꙋпи́цамъ; и҆ да́бы си́це заложе́ный въ Мелхїседе́цѣ, ѡ҆свѧще́ный бы́лъ на Лїтꙋргі́и въ нѣ́коемъ ѿ пред̾идꙋ́щихъ дне́й, и҆ та́кѡ ѡ҆сщ҃е́нъ храни́лсѧ въ Кївѡ́тѣ даже до самогѡ̀ выставле́нїа.“³) Є҆гда̀ же І҆ере́й предꙋготовля́етъ на Проскоми́дїи А҆́гнца хотя́щаго оу҆потреби́тисѧ на выставле́нїи, не и҆́мать глаго́лати надъ не́мъ Словеса̀: Во воспомина́нїе Гдⷭ҇а, и҆ прѡ́ч. нижѐ твори́ти на не́мъ дѣ́йствїа ꙗ҆́же ѻ҆бы́чнѡ тво́рѧтсѧ на

"The Priest ought on Great Thursday at the Liturgy to consecrate two Lambs, and to consume one in Communion, but to place the other in the Pyx (Ciborium), and to keep it in the Tabernacle in the usual place even unto today (unto Friday)." Въ мѣ́стѡ Пѣ́сни Херꙋвї́мскїѧ, та́кѡжде и҆ по пренесе́нїи ст҃ы́хъ Дарѡ́въ, и҆ въ мѣ́стѡ Прича́стника, и҆ въ мѣ́стѡ Да и҆спо́лнѧтсѧ пое́мъ Тропа́рь Ве́чери твоеѧ̀ та́йныѧ. Си́це и҆зда́нїа ѻ҆́бщаѧ; Тѵпі́къ же на́шь рꙋкоп., и҆ на́ши Слꙋже́бници, и҆ Тѵпі́къ Моск. въ мѣ́стѡ Ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ ра́дꙋетсѧ и҆мѣ́ютъ І҆рмо́съ ѳ҃-ыѧ Пѣ́сни Канѡ́на (Стра́нствїа Влады́чна); Еὐχολόγιον же Бенеді́кт. взе́млетъ Ве́чери твоеѧ̀ то́кмо вмѣ́стѡ Ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ ра́дꙋетсѧ. (Въ чи́нѣ Лїтꙋрг. Васі́лїа).
units.english_cohort_translation: 5. units.slavonic_stem_tier2: от начала бычнаго даже до отпетиа тропаря иже
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѿ нача́ла ѻ҆бы́чнагѡ да́же до ѿпѣ́тїа Тропарѧ̀ и҆́же по А҆ллилꙋ́їа, и҆ ѿ Канѡ́на да́же до конца̀ Оу҆́трени, быва́ютъ всѧ̑ по Оу҆ста́вꙋ Оу҆́трени вели́кагѡ Четвертка̀, здѣ̀ на стр. 423; междꙋ̀ же Тропаре́мъ и҆ Канѡ́номъ бꙋ́детъ пѧ́ть Сѣда́лнѡвъ, и҆́хже кі́йждо и҆́мать предъ собо́ю трѝ А҆нтїфѡ́ны Тропаре́й стра́стныхъ, безъ Каѳі́смъ и҆ бе́зъ Є҆кте́нїй ма́лыхъ; та́же Блаже́нны и҆ Прокі́менъ, и҆ Ѱалѡ́мъ н҃. Кромѣ̀ сегѡ̀ чте́мъ в҃і Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїй Стра́стныхъ: а҃. по Тропарѣ̀; є҃ слѣ́дꙋющихъ, по кое́мждо ѿ є҃ Сѣда́лнѡвъ; ѕ҃. по Блаже́нныхъ; и҃. по Ѱалм. н҃; ѳ҃. по Свѣти́лнѣ; і҃. по Хвали́техъ; а҃і. по И҆сполни́мъ; в҃і. по Стїхо́внѣ. По ѿпѣ́тїи коегѡ́ждо Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїа зво́нѧтъ оу҆ на́съ во всѧ̑ клако́лы Це́рко́вныѧ, и҆ по в҃і-мъ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїи престаю́тъ звони́ти да́же до Воскресе́нїѧ; и҆ въ мѣ́стѡ клако́лѡвъ оу҆потребля́ютъ би́ла дре́вѧнаѧ; ѻ҆ба́че оу҆́не оу҆жѐ на Оу҆́трени Стра́ст. не звони́ти, но оу҆даря́ти въ би́ла, и҆лѝ клепа́ла, и҆́бо Оу҆́трена Стра́стнаѧ є҆́сть вре́мѧ сѣ́тованїа, є҆мꙋ́же не согласꙋ́етъ гла́съ ра́достный клако́лѡвъ. Та́кѡжде и҆ въ Ри́мѣ на Оу҆́трени Стра́стн. оу҆жѐ оу҆потребля́ютъ би́ла.
units.english_cohort_translation: **General Overview** From the usual beginning even unto the conclusion of the chanting of the Troparion that is after the Alleluia, and from the Canon even unto the end of Matins, all things are done according to the Typikon of Matins of Great Thursday, here on p. 423 [433]; but between the Troparion and the Canon there are five Sessional Hymns, each of which has before it three Antiphons of Passion Troparia, without Kathismas and without Little Ektenias; then the Beatitudes, and the Prokeimenon, and Psalm 50. Besides this, we read the 12 Passion Gospels: 1st after the Troparion; the 5 following, after each of the 5 Sessional Hymns; the 7th [6th in the original text] after the Beatitudes; the 8th after Psalm 50; the 9th after the Exaposteilarion; the 10th after the Praises; the 11th after "Let us complete"; the 12th after the Aposticha. Upon the completion of the reading of each Gospel, among us they toll all the church bells, and after the 12th Gospel they cease tolling even unto the Resurrection; and instead of bells they use wooden clappers (*byla*); however, it is better already at the Passion Matins not to toll bells, but to strike the wooden boards or *Klepalo*, for Passion Matins is a time of mourning, with which the joyous sound of bells does not harmonize. Likewise in Rome at Passion Matins they already use clappers (*byla*).

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 4 поему тропарю третицею иерей облекся в фелон
units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4. Пое́мꙋ Тропарю̀ трети́цею, І҆ере́й ѡ҆бле́ксѧ въ фелѡ́нъ вїѡлето́вый, и҆́детъ предъ Сте́пени О҆лтарѧ̀, и҆ сотво́рь мета́нїе Ст҃ы́мъ Та́йнамъ, и҆ ѿве́рзъ Ст҃ы̑ѧ Две́ри, глаго́летъ моли́твꙋ кади́ла, и҆ поблагослови́въ Кади́ло съ Благослове́нъ Бг҃ъ на́шь, кади́тъ Ст҃ꙋ́ю Трапе́зꙋ ѻ҆́крестъ; та́же ста́въ пре́дъ степе́ньми Ст҃ы́ѧ Трапе́зы, и҆ покло́ньсѧ глубо́кѡ, и҆схо́дитъ Ст҃ы́ми Две́рми пре́дъ І҆коноста́съ, и҆ кади́тъ намѣ́стныѧ і҆кѡ́ны, и҆ Ли́ки, и҆ Лю́ди, и҆ возвра́щсѧ Ст҃ы́ми Две́рми ко Ст҃и́лище, и҆ ѿда́въ Кади́лницꙋ, и҆ па́ки покло́ньсѧ глубо́кѡ, пое́тъ Є҆кте́нїю ма́лꙋ бе́зъ Возгла́са, та́же и҆схо́дитъ Ст҃ы́ми Две́рми до А҆нало́гїа, и҆ возглаша́етъ И҆ ѡ҆ є҆́же сподо́битисѧ на́мъ, и҆ Ми́ръ всѣ̑мъ, и҆ Премꙋ́дрость про́сти, и҆ прѡ́ч; Ли́къ же въ мѣ́стѡ Сла́ва Тебѣ̀ Гдⷭ҇и ѿвѣщава́етъ: Сла́ва страсте́мъ твои̑мъ Гдⷭ҇и²).
units.english_cohort_translation: 4. While the Troparion is being sung for the third time, the Priest, having vested in a violet phelonion, goes before the steps of the Altar, and having made a metania to the Holy Mysteries and opened the Holy Doors, says the prayer of incense, and having blessed the censer with **"Blessed is our God..."** (*Благослове́нъ Бо́гъ на́шъ*), censes round about the Holy Table; then, standing before the steps of the Holy Table and having bowed deeply, he goes out through the Holy Doors before the Iconostasis and censes the patronal icons, the Choirs, and the people; and having returned through the Holy Doors to the Sanctuary and handed over the censer, and having again bowed deeply, he chants the Little Ektenia without the Exclamation; then he goes out through the Holy Doors to the Analogion, and proclaims: **"And that we may be accounted worthy..."** (*И҆ ѡ҆ є҆́же сподо́битися на́мъ*), and **"Peace be to all"** (*Ми́ръ всѣ̑мъ*), and **"Wisdom! Stand upright!"** (*Премꙋ́дрость, про́сти!*), etc.; and the Choir, instead of **"Glory to Thee, O Lord"** (*Сла́ва Тебѣ̀, Го́споди*), responds: **"Glory to Thy Passion, O Lord"** (*Сла́ва страсте́мъ Твои̑мъ, Го́споди*).[^590]

units.slavonic_incipit: Вся̑ сїя̑ быва́ютъ и҆ на Чте́нїихъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: вся сия бывают и на чтениих прочих еилий
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Вся̑ сїя̑ быва́ютъ и҆ на Чте́нїихъ про́чихъ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїй, ра́звѣ Є҆ктенїй ма́лыя и҆ кажде́нїя, є҆́же по Оу҆ста́вꙋ на́шихъ Трїѡ́дїй, и҆ Тѵпїка̀ Всеꙋчи́лища Львѡ́вск. быва́етъ то́кмо на а҃-мъ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїи, и҆ на є҃ Сѣда́лнѣхъ, и҆ сѐ то́кмо кажде́нїе ст҃ыя Трапе́зы. Глаго́лютъ бо: „Не сѣди́мъ же на сицевѣ́хъ Сѣда́лнахъ, за є҆́же Сщ҃е́нникꙋ кади́ти ст҃ы́й О҆лта́рь, но стоя́ще пое́мъ я҃.“²) Про́чее мни́мъ, ---------------- ¹) Трїѡ́дь на́ша Гре́ч. и҆ Поча́ев., но́ва же Трїѡ́дь Рꙋди́ньска, и҆ Тѵпі́къ Цр҃ьгра́д. прибавля́ютъ є҆щѐ: δόξα σοι;
units.english_cohort_translation: Priest: **"Let us attend!"** (*Во́ньмемъ*), and reads the 1st Gospel; and at the conclusion of the Reading, the Choir, instead of **"Glory to Thee, O Lord"** (*Сла́ва Тебѣ̀, Го́споди*), sings: **"Glory to Thy longsuffering, O Lord"** (*Сла́ва долготерпѣ́нїю Твоему̀, Го́споди*).[^591] The Priest, having kissed the beginning of the Reading, returns into the Sanctuary, and having closed the Holy Doors and bowed down toward the Holy Mysteries, departs to the sacristy, and having divested himself of the phelonion, goes to his place.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ²) Въ Оу҆ста́вѣхъ Гре́ческихъ, и҆ въ є҆ди́нѣй Трїѡ́ди рꙋкоп. Славя́нсткѣй, я҃же и҆́мами, не полага́ется кажде́нїе ни на є҆ди́нѡмъ ѿ в҃і Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїй, нижѐ Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лая. Ѻ҆́ко Це́рк. полага́етъ Є҆ктенїю ма́лꙋю и҆ на а҃-мъ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїи, и҆ пре́дъ всѣ́ми є҃ Сѣда́лными, кажде́нїе же повелѣва́етъ ѡ҆ставля́ти на Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїи и҃. ѳ҃. і҃. и҃ а҃і. Но́вый Тѵпі́къ Царьгра́д. полага́етъ є҆ди́но кажде́нїе, не на Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїи, но въ нача́лѣ Оу҆́тренни во вре́мя Двоѵ̈ѱа́лмїя по Оу҆ста́вꙋ ѻ҆́бщемꙋ Оу҆́трени; но поне́же оу҆ на́съ на ма́лѣй Оу҆́тренни сїѐ кажде́нїе пренебрега́ется, сегѡ̀ ра́ди понѐ здѣ̀ положи́хомъ на а҃-мъ кажде́нїе не то́кмо ст҃ыя Трапе́зы, но и҆ І҆кѡ́нъ и҆ Ли́кѡвъ, я҃кѡже и҆́мать Оу҆ста́въ ѻ҆́бщїй нача́ла Оу҆́трени. А҆́ще же Оу҆ста́ви Гре́ч на си́хъ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїихъ кажде́нїа не полага́ютъ, ничто́же ди́вно, я҃ко въ Тѵпі́цѣхъ Гре́ч. и҆ Славя́ньскихъ на Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїихъ Оу҆́треннихъ кажде́нїе не полага́ется. Ѻ҆́ко Це́рк. полага́етъ на а҃-мъ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїи кажде́нїа два̀, є҆ди́но въ нача́лѣ, то́кмо С. Трапе́зы и҆ всегѡ̀ О҆лтаря̀, дрꙋго́е же въ концѣ̀, всея̀ Це́ркве, и҆ Ѻ҆бразѡвъ и҆ Ли́кѡвъ; на ѕ҃ слѣ́дꙋющихъ, кажде́нїе Ѻ҆бразѡвъ, И҆гꙋ́мена, и҆ Ли́кѡвъ (ѻ҆ба́че здѣ̀ не весьма̀ согласꙋ́етъ себѣ̀, є҆гда̀ глаго́летъ, я҃ко на Сѣда́лнѣхъ І҆ере́й, и҆лѝ Дїа́конъ кади́тъ оу҆ ст҃ыя Трапе́зы); на Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїи и҃. ѳ҃. і҃. и҃ а҃і. ѡ҆ставля́етъ кажде́нїе, а҃ на в҃і па́ки полага́етъ кажде́нїе всея̀ Це́ркве, и҆ Ли́кѡвъ и҆ Бра́тїи. Ѻ҆кꙋ̀ послѣ́дꙋетъ Тѵпі́къ Моск. ѻ҆ба́че на а҃-мъ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїи полага́етъ то́кмо є҆ди́но кажде́нїе въ нача́лѣ, всегѡ̀ Хра́ма; не то́чно же глаго́летъ я҃ко Є҆ктенїи Сѣда́лнѡвъ глаго́лются до и҃-гѡ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїа, я҃ко Сѣда́лни сяга́ютъ то́кмо до ѕ҃ гѡ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїя. Оу҆ста́ви Гре́ч. а҃́ще и҆ не полага́ютъ Кажде́нїя на Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїихъ, ѻ҆ба́че на Сѣда́лникѣхъ повелѣва́ютъ стоя́ти. Οὐ καθήμεθα δὲ ἐν τοῖς τοιούτοις Καθίσμασιν, ἀλλ’ ἱστάμενοι ψάλλομεν αὐτὰ.
units.english_cohort_translation: All these things take place also at the Readings of the other Gospels, except for the Little Ektenia and the censing, which according to the Typikon of our Triodia and the Typikon of the University of Lviv takes place only at the 1st Gospel, and at the 5 Sessional Hymns, and this only the censing of the Holy Table. For they say: "We do not sit at such Sessional Hymns, because the Priest censes the holy Altar, but standing we chant them."[^592] For the rest, we deem that one ought to cense not only at the Sessional Hymns, but also at all the other Gospels, for the censing is not for the sake of the Sessional Hymns, but for the sake of the Gospels, yet only around the Holy Table, as our Triodia have it, which mention censing only of the Holy Table; but it suffices to cense everything only twice, that is, at the 1st Gospel, and in the Canon at the Heirmos of the 4th Ode.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: (Дїа́коны, а҃ще бꙋ́дꙋтъ, ѡ҆бле́кшеся ѿ нача́ла Оу҆́трени въ Далма́тїки вїѡлето́выя съ Ѻ҆раре́мъ, пребыва́ютъ во Ст҃и́лищи на свои́хъ мѣ́стѣхъ, до́ндеже начнетсѧ пѣ́ти трети́цею Тропа́рь Є҆гда̀ сла́внїи Оу҆ченицѝ; тогда́ бо прише́дше съ І҆ере́емъ хотя́щимъ пѣ́ти Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе, ѡ҆блече́нымъ въ фелѡ́нъ вїѡлето́вый, пре́дъ сте́пены О҆лтаря̀, и҆ покло́ньшеся кꙋ́пнѡ съ ни́мъ къ Ст҃ы́мъ Та́йнамъ, ѿверза́ютъ Ст҃ы̑я Две́ри, кадя́тъ вся̑ по ѻ҆бы́чаю, я҃кѡже въ нача́лѣ Лїтꙋргі́и, и҆ возвраща́ются пре́дъ сте́пени О҆лтаря̀, та́же ѿда́вше Кади́льници, и҆ покло́ньшеся ѻ҆́ба ра́внѡ къ Ст҃ы́мъ Та́йнамъ, и҆схо́дятъ кі́йждо свои́ми две́рьми пре́дъ Ца́рская Брата̀ и҆ покло́ньшеся па́ки къ Ст҃ы́мъ Та́йнамъ, ста́нꙋтъ та́мо, до́ндеже Дїа́конъ вторы́й по ѿпѣ́тїи Тропаря̀ не и҆зрече́тъ Є҆ктенїю ма́лꙋю; тогда́ бо покло́ньшеся къ Ст҃ы́мъ Та́йнамъ, и҆ премѣ́ньше своя̑ страны̀, постꙋпа́ютъ до А҆нало́гїа, я҃коже, прише́дшꙋ І҆ере́ю до А҆нало́гїа, бы́ти пе́рвомꙋ Дїа́конꙋ ѡ҆деснꙋ́ю є҆гѡ̀, второ́мꙋ же ѡ҆шꙋ́юю. Покло́ньшꙋся оу҆́бо І҆ере́ю къ Ст҃ы́мъ Та́йнамъ, и҆ прише́дшꙋ Ст҃ы́ми Две́рьми до А҆нало́гїа, возглаша́етъ пе́рвый Дїа́конъ: И҆ ѡ҆ є҆́же сподо́битися на́мъ, І҆ере́й: Ми́ръ всѣ̑мъ, Дїа́конъ вторы́й: Премꙋ́дрость про́сти оу҆слы́шимъ, І҆ере́й: Ѿ И҆́мкъ, Дїа́конъ пе́рвый: Во́ньмѣмъ, І҆ере́й Чте́нїе. Ѻ҆конча́ннꙋ же Чте́нїю, цѣлꙋ́етъ І҆ере́й нача́ло Чте́нїя пре́жде са́мъ, та́же Дїа́конъ десны́й, а҆ по не́мъ и҆ лѣ́вый, и҆ возвраща́ются всѝ трїѐ во Ст҃и́лище, І҆ере́й сре́дними, Дїа́кони же поко́чными Две́рьми, и҆ ста́вше кꙋ́пно съ І҆ере́емъ пре́дъ сте- ---------------- ¹) Въ Патрїа́рхїи Царьгра́д. а҃-е Патрїа́рхъ, в҃і. же Вел. И҆рхїдїа́конъ и҆зъ А҆мвѡ́на, въ нача́лѣ на Двоѵ̈ѱа́лмїи кади́тъ ὁ Μ. Ἀρχιμανδρίτης, ἐνδεδυμένος χρυσοῦν φελώνιον. (Но́в. Тѵп. Царьгра́д.)
units.english_cohort_translation: (The Deacons, if there be any, having vested from the beginning of Matins in violet dalmatics with the orarion, remain in the Sanctuary at their places until the Troparion **"When the glorious disciples"** (*Є҆гда̀ сла́внїи оу҆чени́цы*) begins to be sung for the third time; for then, having come with the Priest who is about to sing the Gospel, vested in a violet phelonion, before the steps of the Altar, and having bowed together with him toward the Holy Mysteries, they open the Holy Doors, cense all things according to custom, as at the beginning of the Liturgy, and return before the steps of the Altar; then, having handed over the censers and both bowed equally toward the Holy Mysteries, they go out each through his own door before the Royal Doors, and having bowed again toward the Holy Mysteries, they stand there until the second Deacon, after the chanting of the Troparion, recites the Little Ektenia; for then, having bowed toward the Holy Mysteries and changed their sides, they advance to the Analogion, so that, when the Priest has come to the Analogion, the first Deacon is at his right hand, and the second at his left. When the Priest has bowed toward the Holy Mysteries and come through the Holy Doors to the Analogion, the first Deacon proclaims: **"And that we may be accounted worthy..."** (*И҆ ѡ҆ є҆́же сподо́битися на́мъ*); Priest: **"Peace be to all"** (*Ми́ръ всѣ̑мъ*); second Deacon: **"Wisdom! Stand upright! Let us hear..."** (*Премꙋ́дрость, про́сти, оу҆слы́шимъ*); Priest: **"The Reading from N."** (*Ѿ и҆́мрекъ*); first Deacon: **"Let us attend!"** (*Во́ньмемъ*); Priest reads the Reading. When the Reading is finished, the Priest kisses the beginning of the Reading first himself, then the Deacon on the right, and after him also the one on the left, and all three return into the Sanctuary, the Priest through the middle doors, and the Deacons through the side doors; and standing together with the Priest before the steps of the Altar, they close the Holy Doors, and having all bowed equally toward the Holy Mysteries, they depart to their places. At the other Gospels, since the Little Ektenia is not said, the Deacons, having come before the Holy Doors, bow, and having changed their sides, go to the Analogion; and the Priest having taken his stand in their midst, they proclaim: **"And that we may be accounted worthy..."** (*И҆ ѡ҆ є҆́же сподо́битися*), and the rest, as above.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: пеньми О҆лтаря̀, затворя́ютъ Ст҃ы̑я Две́ри, и҆ покло́ньшеся всѝ ра́внѡ Ст҃ы́мъ Та́йнамъ, ѿхо́дятъ на своя̑ мѣ́ста. units.english_cohort_translation: If it happens that a Hierarch or other sacred dignitaries are present, the Deacons ought to cense them before the Choirs, and neither the Priest nor the Deacons are to kiss the Gospel before the Hierarch and sacred dignitaries; and for this reason both Deacons carry the open Gospel together to them for kissing, then to the Priest standing in the Holy Doors; and when they have kissed it, they also kiss the same, and place it upon the Analogion; and having bowed deeply toward the Holy Mysteries, they return, each through his own door, into the Sanctuary.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся пристꙋ́пствовати И҆рхїере́еви, и҆лѝ и҆ны́мъ Священнодосто́йникѡмъ, подоба́етъ Дїа́конѡмъ кади́ти и҆́хъ пре́жде Ли́кѡвъ, и҆ нижѐ І҆ере́ю, нижѐ Дїа́конѡмъ цѣлова́ти Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе пре́жде И҆рхїере́а, и҆ Священнодосто́йникѡвъ; и҆ сегѡ̀ ра́ди Дїа́кони понесо́тъ ѻ҆́ба кꙋ́пнѡ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе ѿве́рзто ко цѣлова́нїю тѣ́мже, та́же до І҆ере́я стоя́щагѡ во Ст҃ы́хъ Две́рехъ, и҆́же є҆гда̀ поцѣлꙋ́ютъ є҆̀, цѣлꙋ́ютъ и҆ ѻ҆нѝ то́еже, и҆ возглага́ютъ на А҆нало́гїи; и҆ покло́ньшеся глубо́кѡ къ Ст҃ы́мъ Та́йнамъ, возвраща́ются кі́йждо свои́ми Две́рьми, во Ст҃и́лище.

units.slavonic_incipit: ⁵) Тѵпі́къ но́вый Царьгра́д. взе́млетъ Ѿпꙋ́стъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: типик новый царьград вземлет отпуст великий мы
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ⁵) Тѵпі́къ но́вый Царьгра́д. взе́млетъ Ѿпꙋ́стъ вели́кїй, мы́ же ѻ҆бы́чай и҆́маин глаго́лати вели́кїй на Оу҆́треняхъ вели́кихъ.
units.english_cohort_translation: On Friday morning, before the beginning of the Royal Hours, there are placed upon the Holy Table the Plashchanytsia and the most beautiful Gospel, and there is erected before the Royal Doors the Tomb of Christ, beside which, according to the custom of the Northern and Western Latin Churches,[^602] the Holy Mysteries are exposed even until the Resurrection of Christ. And our Sluzhebnyks indeed command the Tabernacle (*Kivot*) with the Holy Mysteries to be placed upon such a Tomb; but the custom of our Cathedral Church is to expose the Holy Mysteries in the Monstrance (*Darookazalnytsia*) upon the High Altar, and to erect the Tomb of the Lord thus: above it there stands a Cross without the Crucified, with a shroud hung upon its crossbeam, and with the Instruments of Christ's Passion; it is adorned with costly cloth, and surrounded with many candlesticks and lamps, and vessels with small trees and flowers. The front board of the Sarcophagus is covered with crimson damask, to which is attached a white cloth, to which later the Plashchanytsia is to be pinned; the board itself is not flat, but inclined, so that the Plashchanytsia pinned to it may be visible and more accessible for kissing.
units.slavonic_text: ⁵) Тѵпі́къ но́вый Царьгра́д. взе́млетъ Ѿпꙋ́стъ вели́кїй, мы́ же ѻ҆бы́чай и҆́маин глаго́лати вели́кїй на Оу҆́треняхъ вели́кихъ.

units.slavonic_incipit: ²) По Оу҆ста́вꙋ Трїѡ́ди Гре́ч и҆
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: по оуставу триоди греч и нашея почаевск
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ²) По Оу҆ста́вꙋ Трїѡ́ди Гре́ч и҆ на́шея Поча́евск. и҆ Тѵп. Моск. пою́тся всѝ кꙋ́пнѡ Ѽ Часѣ̀ в҃. днѐ; по Тѵп. на́шемꙋ рꙋкоп Ча́съ а҃. Ѽ Часѣ̀ а҃. днѐ, про́чїи Ѽ Часѣ̀ ґ. днѐ. По Ѻ҆́кꙋ Це́рк всѝ Ѽ Часѣ̀ ґ. днѐ; по Тѵп. но́в. Царьгра́д. Ѽ Часѣ̀ а҃. днѐ.
units.english_cohort_translation: In the Cathedral Church they are sung at the 10th hour of the morning, together with the Typika (*Obidnytsia*) and with Vespers.[^603] We sing all things according to the Typikon of the Royal Hours of the Paramony of the Nativity of Christ, here on p. 181. However, since the Tomb is placed before the Royal Doors, the Analogion of the Gospel is placed a little below it, while the Analogion of the other Readings is placed still lower than this. And all things which at the Paramony of the Nativity the sacred ministers say before the Royal Doors, here they say before the Tomb; but they do not cense the Tomb, because until now there is nothing within it.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 3 в место прокимена дневнаго будет прокимен триоди
units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3. Въ мѣ́сто Прокі́мена дневна́гѡ бꙋ́детъ Прокі́менъ Трїѡ́ди, и҆ Парїмі́а, и҆ тре́тїя Парїмі́а; та́же тре́тїй Прокі́менъ, и҆́же є҆́сть А҆пⷭ҇ла, и҆ А҆пⷭ҇лъ, и҆ А҆ллилꙋ́їа, и҆ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе. На А҆ллилꙋ́їа быва́етъ кажде́нїе. Во́ньмѣмъ, Ми́ръ всѣ̑мъ, Премꙋ́дрость, во́ньмѣмъ глаго́лемъ то́кмо на а҃-мъ и҆ г҃-мъ Прокі́менѣ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе начина́емъ ѿ Премꙋ́дрость Про́сти. Въ мѣ́сто Сла́ва Тебѣ̀ Гдⷭ҇и, пре́жде Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїа глаго́лемъ: Сла́ва Страсте́мъ твои̑мъ Гдⷭ҇и, по́слѣ же Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїя: Сла́ва долготерпѣ́нїю твоемꙋ̀ Гдⷭ҇и, та́кѡжде и҆ на Оу҆́трени.
units.english_cohort_translation: 3. units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 5 на последней стихире стиховны сиреч на теб
units.slavonic_diplomatic: 5. На послѣ́дней Стїхи́рѣ Стїхо́вны, си́рѣчь на Тебѐ ѡ҆дѣ́ющагося свѣ́томъ, быва́етъ ѻ҆бхо́дъ съ Плащани́цею, и҆ низложе́нїе є҆я̀ во Гро́бъ, по ѻ҆бы́чаю Престо́льныхъ на́шихъ Церкве́й, си́це: Во вре́мя пѣ́нїя Стїхо́вны оу҆ряжда́ется Похо́дъ на Це́ркви; и҆ поста́влен- ---------------- p. 312.). Ѻ҆писꙋ́ется же въ Слꙋже́бницѣхъ на́шихъ и҆зда́нныхъ въ Поча́евѣ є҆щѐ за Станїсла́ва А҆ѵгꙋ́ста 1767, по́слѣ же въ Тѵпі́цѣхъ Россїйскихъ, и҆ въ но́вомъ Тѵпі́цѣ Патрїархі́я Царьгра́дскагѡ; ѻ҆ба́че въ на́шихъ Слꙋже́бницѣхъ полага́ется похо́дъ съ Плащани́цею то́кмо на Вече́рни, въ Россїйскихъ Оу҆ста́вѣхъ то́кмо на Оу҆́тренни Сꙋббѡ́тнѣй по вел. Славосло́вїи, въ Тѵпі́цѣ же Царьгра́д. и҆знесе́нїе на Хра́мъ до Гро́ба полага́ется на Вече́рни, по́слѣ же похо́дъ ѻ҆́крестъ Хра́ма на Оу҆́трени.
units.english_cohort_translation: 5. At the last Sticheron of the Aposticha, that is at **"Thou Who clothest Thyself with light"** (*Тебѐ ѡ҆дѣ́ющагося свѣ́томъ*), there takes place the procession with the Plashchanytsia, and its deposition into the Tomb, according to the custom of our Cathedral Churches, thus: During the chanting of the Aposticha the Procession is arranged in the church; and the Monstrance (*Darookazalnytsia*) having been placed to the left on the Altar, the candles are lit on the Altar and on the Tomb, and the sacred ministers vest: the Hierarch and four most worthy Choir-clerics who are to carry the Plashchanytsia in all the sacred vestments of their Order, while the other Choir-clerics and Priests vest only in epitrachelia and phelonia, and others only in epitrachelia, and two Deacons in all the diaconal vestments. Burning candles are distributed to all the Choir-clerics and other Priests in the Sanctuary, and to the Brotherhood in the church; and the sacred ministers having approached the steps of the Altar and bowed deeply, the Hierarch ascends to the Altar, and having taken the Plashchanytsia spread out upon the Altar, hands it to four Choir-clerics, so that each holds one of its corners. Then the Deacon on the right ascends to the Altar, and having bowed deeply, brings out the Tabernacle (*Kivot*) with the Holy Mysteries, and having placed it upon the (folded) Iliton, takes out from it the Lamb with the pyx (*kletka*) in which It rests, not touching It with fingers, but holding by the pyx, and places It into the Monstrance (*Darookazalnytsia*), having securely closed it; and having closed the Tabernacle, he places it into the Tabernacle-shrine (*Skynia*), and having bowed and closed it, and having placed the Monstrance in the midst of the Iliton facing the people, he steps back a little to the side, until the Hierarch, kneeling, censes the Holy Mysteries thrice, each time with a bow at the end, and having taken upon himself the small omophorion (*omophorets*), approaches the Holy Table; for then the Deacon, having bowed down before the Holy Mysteries and taken Them with both hands, delivers Them to the Hierarch, who has first made a metania, who turns by the right toward the people; and the Singers beginning to sing **"Thou Who clothest Thyself"** (*Тебѐ ѡ҆дѣ́ющагося*), he goes out behind the Clergy from the Royal Doors by the north side of the Tomb into the church; and having entered under the Baldachin, surrounded by candle-bearers, with the two Deacons preceding and censing unceasingly, he advances behind all to the Doors of the church,

units.slavonic_incipit: и҆дꙋ́щꙋ пре́жде всѣ́хъ Крестоно́сцꙋ, та́же Хорꙋгвоно́сцемъ,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: идущу прежде всех крестоносцу таже хоругвоносцем таже четырем
units.slavonic_diplomatic: и҆дꙋ́щꙋ пре́жде всѣ́хъ Крестоно́сцꙋ, та́же Хорꙋгвоно́сцемъ, та́же четы́ремъ Дѣ́вамъ І҆кононо́сицамъ, та́же Бра́тствꙋ Церко́вномꙋ, Воспи́танникѡмъ Сѣ́менища, Ли́кꙋ Пѣвце́въ Сѣ́менища, та́же ѿ Ца́рскихъ Бра́тъ І҆ере́емъ, Клироша́нѡмъ, Четы́ремъ Священнодосто́йникѡмъ несꙋ́щимъ Плащани́цꙋ, ѡ҆браще́нꙋ нога́ми къ лю́демъ; въ концѝ же И҆рхїере́ю съ Дїа́коны кадя́щими, и҆ свѣще́но́сци; и҆сходя̀ же похо́дъ ѿ Це́ркве, свраща́ется на де́снѡ, си́рѣчь на Сѣ́верный є҆я̀ бо́къ, и҆ ѡ҆бше́дъ ю҆ г҃-жды, (и҆лѝ я҃кѡже дне́сь та́мѡ творя́тъ, а҃-жды) возвраща́ется въ Це́рковь; и҆ ста́вшимъ, и҆́же съ Плащани́цею, и҆ про́чимъ І҆ере́емъ, предъ Гро́бомъ, И҆рхїере́й со Дїа́коны возвраща́ется ю҆́жною страно́ю Гро́ба, Ца́рьскими же Браты̀, въ О҆лта́рь, и҆ прїе́мшꙋ Дїа́конꙋ десно́мꙋ ѿ рꙋ́къ є҆гѡ̀ Ст҃ы̑я Та́йны, и҆ поста́вившꙋ на Ст҃ѣ́й Трапе́зѣ, И҆рхїере́й прикло́нь колѣ́нѣ, и҆ ѿло́жь Ѻ҆мофо́рїй (Velum); кади́тъ я҃ г҃-жды съ главоприклоне́нїемъ, Дїа́конъ же покло́нься выставля́етъ я҃ верхꙋ̀ Ски́нїи; та́же покло́ньшеся всѝ трїѐ пре́дъ степе́ньми О҆лтаря̀, и҆схо́дятъ, И҆рхїере́й оу҆́бо сре́дными, Дїа́коны же поко́чными Две́рьми, предъ Гро́бъ, и҆ прїе́мъ И҆рхїере́й Плащани́цꙋ ѿ Клироша́нъ держа́щихъ ю҆, возглага́етъ на Гро́бъ, ѻ҆ни́ же припина́ютъ ю҆ до Гро́ба; и҆ є҆гда̀ Пѣвцѝ соверша́тъ Ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши, и҆ Трист҃о́е и҆ про́чее съ О҆́ч҃е на́шъ, возглаша́етъ И҆рхїере́й Я҆́ко твоѐ є҆́сть Ца́рьство, и҆ нача́нъ пое́тъ съ сослꙋжа́щими Тропа́рь Бл҃гообра́зный І҆ѡ́сифъ, и҆ при концѝ твори́тъ съ Сослꙋжа́щими мета́нїе глубо́кое, всѝ же лю́дїе покло́нъ вели́кїй до землѝ; та́же втори́цею то́йже Тропа́рь Ли́къ вторы́й, и҆ всѝ мета́нїе и҆ покло́нъ, я҃кѡже пре́жде. И҆ и҆дѣ́же то́кмо є҆ди́нъ Ли́къ бꙋ́детъ, то перви́цею Тропа́рь се́й пою́тъ Священнослꙋжи́телїе, втори́цею Ли́къ, трети́цею полови́нꙋ Священнослꙋжи́телїе, про́чее же ѿ Плащани́цею, и҆ ни́жае Ли́къ¹). И҆ по ѿпѣ́тїи Тропаря̀ и҆ по покло́нѣхъ цѣлꙋ́ютъ Плащани́цꙋ, всѝ по чи́нꙋ, сотво́рше пре́жде цѣлова́нїя мета́нїе є҆ди́но, пре́жде И҆рхїере́й, та́же про́чїи Священнослꙋжи́телїе по чи́нꙋ досто́иньства своегѡ̀; и҆ быва́етъ Ѿпꙋ́стъ вели́ктїй, сво́йственный се́й Сꙋббѡ́тѣ, по не́мъ же Священнослꙋжи́телїе возвраща́ются въ О҆лта́рь и҆ ѡ҆ста́вльше ѿве́рста Ца́рская Брата̀, да́же до конца̀ Седми́ци Свѣ́тлыя, и҆звлека́ются ѿ сщ҃е́нныхъ ѡ҆де́ждъ, и҆ и҆́дꙋтъ во своя̑ сѝ, лю́дїе же послѣ́дꙋютъ цѣлова́ти Плащани́цꙋ²).
units.english_cohort_translation: the Cross-bearer going before all, then the Banner-bearers, then four maidens bearing icons, then the Church Brotherhood, the students of the Seminary, the Choir of singers of the Seminary, then from the Royal Doors the Priests, the Choir-clerics, the four sacred dignitaries carrying the Plashchanytsia facing with its feet toward the people; and at the end the Hierarch with the Deacons censing, and the candle-bearers. As the procession exits from the church, it turns to the right, that is to its northern side, and having circled it thrice (or as they do there today, once), returns into the church; and those with the Plashchanytsia and the other Priests having halted before the Tomb, the Hierarch with the Deacons returns by the south side of the Tomb, through the Royal Doors, into the Sanctuary; and the Deacon on the right having received from his hands the Holy Mysteries and placed Them upon the Holy Table, the Hierarch, having bent his knees and laid aside the Omophorion (Velum), censes Them thrice with the bowing of his head; and the Deacon, having bowed, exposes Them above the Tabernacle-shrine (*Skynia*); then all three having bowed before the steps of the Altar, they go out, the Hierarch through the middle doors, and the Deacons through the side doors, before the Tomb; and the Hierarch, having received the Plashchanytsia from the Choir-clerics holding it, lays it upon the Tomb, and they pin it down to the Tomb; and when the Singers finish **"Now lettest Thou depart"** (*Ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши*), and the Trisagion and the rest with **"Our Father"** (*Ѡ҆́тче на́шъ*), the Hierarch exclaims: **"For Thine is the Kingdom"** (*Я҆́ко Твоѐ є҆́сть Ца́рство*), and beginning, sings with the concelebrants the Troparion **"The noble Joseph"** (*Благообра́зный Іѡ́сифъ*), and at the end makes with the concelebrants a deep metania, while all the people make a great prostration to the ground; then for the second time the same Troparion the second Choir [sings], and all make a metania and prostration as before. And where there is only one Choir, then the first time this Troparion is sung by the sacred ministers, the second time by the Choir, the third time half by the sacred ministers, and the remainder from the Plashchanytsia and below by the Choir.[^605] And after the chanting of the Troparion and after the prostrations they kiss the Plashchanytsia, all according to rank, having made before the kissing a single metania, first the Hierarch, then the other sacred ministers according to the order of their dignity; and there takes place the Great Dismissal proper to this Saturday, after which the sacred ministers return into the Sanctuary, and having left the Royal Doors open even until the end of Bright Week, divest themselves of the sacred vestments, and go each to his own home; while the people follow to kiss the Plashchanytsia.[^606]

И҆ и҆дѣ́же то́кмо є҆ди́нъ Ли́къ бꙋ́детъ, то перви́цею Тропа́рь се́й пою́тъ Священнослꙋжи́телїе, втори́цею Ли́къ, трети́цею полови́нꙋ Священнослꙋжи́телїе, про́чее же ѿ Плащани́цею, и҆ ни́жае Ли́къ¹). И҆ по ѿпѣ́тїи Тропаря̀ и҆ по покло́нѣхъ цѣлꙋ́ютъ Плащани́цꙋ, всѝ по чи́нꙋ, сотво́рше пре́жде цѣлова́нїя мета́нїе є҆ди́но, пре́жде И҆рхїере́й, та́же про́чїи Священнослꙋжи́телїе по чи́нꙋ досто́иньства своегѡ̀; и҆ быва́етъ Ѿпꙋ́стъ вели́ктїй, сво́йственный се́й Сꙋббѡ́тѣ, по не́мъ же Священнослꙋжи́телїе возвраща́ются въ О҆лта́рь и҆ ѡ҆ста́вльше ѿве́рста Ца́рская Брата̀, да́же до конца̀ Седми́ци Свѣ́тлыя, и҆звлека́ются ѿ сщ҃е́нныхъ ѡ҆де́ждъ, и҆ и҆́дꙋтъ во своя̑ сѝ, лю́дїе же послѣ́дꙋютъ цѣлова́ти Плащани́цꙋ²).
units.english_text: the Cross-bearer going before all, then the Banner-bearers, then four maidens bearing icons, then the Church Brotherhood, the students of the Seminary, the Choir of singers of the Seminary, then from the Royal Doors the Priests, the Choir-clerics, the four sacred dignitaries carrying the Plashchanytsia facing with its feet toward the people; and at the end the Hierarch with the Deacons censing, and the candle-bearers. As the procession exits from the church, it turns to the right, that is to its northern side, and having circled it thrice (or as they do there today, once), returns into the church; and those with the Plashchanytsia and the other Priests having halted before the Tomb, the Hierarch with the Deacons returns by the south side of the Tomb, through the Royal Doors, into the Sanctuary; and the Deacon on the right having received from his hands the Holy Mysteries and placed Them upon the Holy Table, the Hierarch, having bent his knees and laid aside the Omophorion (Velum), censes Them thrice with the bowing of his head; and the Deacon, having bowed, exposes Them above the Tabernacle-shrine (*Skynia*); then all three having bowed before the steps of the Altar, they go out, the Hierarch through the middle doors, and the Deacons through the side doors, before the Tomb; and the Hierarch, having received the Plashchanytsia from the Choir-clerics holding it, lays it upon the Tomb, and they pin it down to the Tomb; and when the Singers finish **"Now lettest Thou depart"** (*Ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши*), and the Trisagion and the rest with **"Our Father"** (*Ѡ҆́тче на́шъ*), the Hierarch exclaims: **"For Thine is the Kingdom"** (*Я҆́ко Твоѐ є҆́сть Ца́рство*), and beginning, sings with the concelebrants the Troparion **"The noble Joseph"** (*Благообра́зный Іѡ́сифъ*), and at the end makes with the concelebrants a deep metania, while all the people make a great prostration to the ground; then for the second time the same Troparion the second Choir [sings], and all make a metania and prostration as before. And where there is only one Choir, then the first time this Troparion is sung by the sacred ministers, the second time by the Choir, the third time half by the sacred ministers, and the remainder from the Plashchanytsia and below by the Choir.[^605] And after the chanting of the Troparion and after the prostrations they kiss the Plashchanytsia, all according to rank, having made before the kissing a single metania, first the Hierarch, then the other sacred ministers according to the order of their dignity; and there takes place the Great Dismissal proper to this Saturday, after which the sacred ministers return into the Sanctuary, and having left the Royal Doors open even until the end of Bright Week, divest themselves of the sacred vestments, and go each to his own home; while the people follow to kiss the Plashchanytsia.[^606]

Дꙋшпа́стырь, а҃ще и҆́мать бо́льше Церкве́й, въ Ма́терней оу҆́бо пое́тъ Вече́рню съ и҆знесе́нїемъ Плащани́ци, въ дще́рныхъ же то́кмо и҆зно́ситъ Плащани́цꙋ, си́це: по Бл҃гослове́нъ Бг҃ъ на́шь и҆ Прїиди́те поклони́мся г҃, а҆́бїе Похо́дъ съ Тебѐ ѡ҆дѣ́ющагося, и҆ по Похо́дѣ: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, и҆ Ѿпꙋ́стъ, и҆ Бл҃гообра́зный І҆ѡ́сифъ г҃, съ покло́ны.
units.english_cohort_translation: 2. The Pastor of souls, even if he has several churches, in the mother church sings Vespers with the carrying out of the Plashchanytsia, but in filial churches only carries out the Plashchanytsia, thus: after **"Blessed is our God"** (*Благослове́нъ Бо́гъ на́шъ*) and **"Come, let us worship"** (*Прїиди́те, поклони́мся*) thrice, immediately the Procession with **"Thou Who clothest Thyself"** (*Тебѐ ѡ҆дѣ́ющагося*), and after the Procession: **"Glory to Thee, O Christ God"** (*Сла́ва Тебѣ̀, Христѐ Бо́же*), and the Dismissal, and **"The noble Joseph"** (*Благообра́зный Іѡ́сифъ*) thrice, with prostrations.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 2 священнослужителие пребывают чрез всю оутреню пред бжиим
units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2. Священнослꙋжи́телїе пребыва́ютъ чрезъ всю̀ Оу҆́треню предъ Бж҃їимъ Гро́бомъ, и҆дѣ́же поставля́ются и҆́мъ Сѣда́лища, и҆ Трапе́за со ---------------- Σαββάτου (τελουμένου τούτου συνήθως κατὰ τὴν ἑσπέραν τῆς μεγ. Παρασκευῆς), ὅπου πάλιν εἰς τὸ τέλος τῆς Δοξολογίας τῆς μεγ. εἰς τὸ Ἅγιος ὁ Θεὸς ἐκφέρεται ὁ Ἐπιτάφιος, ἀλλὰ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἔσωθεν καὶ ἔξωθεν κατὰ τὰς περιστάσεις, καὶ πάλιν ἐναποτίθεται εἰς τὴν ἰδίαν τράπεζαν, μέχρι τῆς ὥρας τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ μεγ. Σαββάτου, ὅτε ἰδιωτικῶς παρ’ ἑνὸς Ἱερέως μετ’ Ἐπιτραχήλιον τίθεται εἰς τὸ Βῆμα εἰς τὸν συνήθη τόπον.
units.english_cohort_translation: 2. The sacred ministers remain throughout the whole Matins before the Lord's Tomb, where seats are placed for them, and a table with candlesticks and Books, so that sitting they may sing from there the Order, the Priests in epitrachelia and phelonia, and the Deacons in dalmatics, of violet color.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 1 от блгословен бг наш даже до приидите
units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1. Ѿ Бл҃гослове́нъ Бг҃ъ на́шь да́же до Прїиди́те поклони́мся и҆склю́чнѡ, вся̑ я҃кѡже ѻ҆бы́чнѡ на Оу҆́трени; та́же по в҃і Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй, ѡ҆пꙋсти́вше Прїиди́те поклони́мся, а҆́бїе І҆ере́й Сла́ва ст҃ѣ́й, и҆ прѡ́чая съ Шестоѱа́лмїемъ да́же до Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь, я҃кѡже ѻ҆бы́чнѡ.¹) 2. На Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь Тропа́рь Бл҃гообра́зный І҆ѡ́сифъ, в҃-жды. Сла́ва: Є҆гда̀ снизше́лъ є҆сѝ, И҆ ны́нѣ: Мѵроно́сицамъ.²) 3. Каѳі́сма з҃і. (Непоро́чни) на трѝ Статі́й, съ Тропарѝ надгро́бными, съ кажде́нїемъ въ нача́лѣ коея́ждо Статі́й, и҆ Є҆кте́нїею ма́лою по кое́йждо Статі́й.
units.english_cohort_translation: **Typikon** 1. From **"Blessed is our God"** (*Благослове́нъ Бо́гъ на́шъ*) even unto **"Come, let us worship"** (*Прїиди́те, поклони́мся*) exclusively, all as usually at Matins; then after the 12 **"Lord, have mercy"**, having omitted **"Come, let us worship"**, immediately the Priest: **"Glory to the holy..."** (*Сла́ва святѣ́й*), and the rest with the Six Psalms even unto **"The Lord is God"** (*Бо́гъ Госпо́дь*), as usually.[^607]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆ Тропарѣ́хъ надгро́бныхъ, нарица́емыхъ въ Трїѡ́дехъ Гре́ческихъ Ἐγκώμια (Похвалы̀), вѣ́стно бꙋ́ди я҃ко коемꙋ́ждо ѿ ни́хъ предпѣва́ется є҆ди́нъ сті́хъ Каѳі́смы, до́ндеже всѝ соверша́тся; то́кмо а҃-ый Тропа́рь коея́ждо Статі́й (въ и҆зда́нїяхъ же Трїѡ́дїй на́шихъ Поча́евскихъ та́кѡжде и҆ в҃-їй Тропа́рь Статі́й в҃-ыя)
units.english_cohort_translation: 2. At **"The Lord is God"**, Troparion: **"The noble Joseph"** (*Благообра́зный Іѡ́сифъ*) twice. **"Glory"**: **"When Thou didst descend unto death"** (*Є҆гда̀ снизше́лъ є҆сѝ къ сме́рти*); **"Both now"**: **"Unto the Myrrh-bearing Women"** (*Мѵроно́сицамъ жена́мъ*).[^608]

units.slavonic_incipit: ³) Трїѡ́дь на́ша Поча́ев. ничто́же повелѣва́етъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: триод наша почаев ничтоже повелевает кадити глаголющи
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ³) Трїѡ́дь на́ша Поча́ев. ничто́же повелѣва́етъ кади́ти, глаго́лющи то́кмо: „И҆ покади́въ крестообра́знѡ“. Трїѡ́дь Гре́ч. помина́етъ кажде́нїе то́кмо на в҃-й и҆ г҃-й Статі́й, а҆ не глаго́летъ, что̀ и҆́мать кади́тися. Ѻ҆ко пое́тся безъ Стїха̀, сѐ же и҆ въ нача́лѣ и҆ въ концѝ Статі́й, ра́звѣ Статі́й г҃-їя, по не́йже Тропа́рь а҃-вый не пое́тся, нижѐ Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лая глаго́лется, но а҆́бїе А҆́нгелскїй Собо́ръ, и҆ по ѿпѣ́тїи сегѡ̀ Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лая.
units.english_cohort_translation: Concerning the Funeral Troparia, called in the Greek Triodia *Ἐγκώμια* (Praises / *Pokhvaly*), be it known that before each of them is chanted one verse of the Kathisma, until all are completed; only the 1st Troparion of each Stasis (and in the editions of our Pochaiv Triodia also the 2nd Troparion of the 2nd Stasis) is sung without a Verse, and this both at the beginning and at the end of the Stasis, except for the 3rd Stasis, after which the 1st Troparion is not sung, nor is the Little Ektenia said, but immediately **"The Angelic Host"** (*А҆́нгельскїй собо́ръ*), and after its chanting the Little Ektenia.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: По г҃-й Пѣ́сни Сѣда́ленъ, по ѕ҃-й Конд-І҆́косъ, на ѳ҃-й Честнѣ́йшꙋю не пое́мъ,¹) и҆ по ѳ҃-й Досто́йнѡ не глаго́лемъ, но І҆рмо́съ, и҆ по́слѣ въ мѣ́стѡ Свѣти́лна пое́мъ Ст҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ на́шъ г҃.
units.english_cohort_translation: After the 3rd Ode, the Sessional Hymn; after the 6th, the Kontakion and Ikos; at the 9th Ode we do not sing **"More honorable"** (*Честнѣ́йшꙋю*),[^610] and after the 9th [Ode] we do not say **"It is truly right"** (*Досто́йно є҆́сть*), but the Heirmos; and afterwards instead of the Exaposteilarion we sing **"Holy is the Lord our God"** (*Свѧ́тъ Госпо́дь Бо́гъ на́шъ*) thrice.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ---------------- Це́рк. полага́етъ кажде́нїе на а҃-й Статі́й, всея̀ Це́ркве, и҆ Бра́тїи по чи́нꙋ, на про́чихъ же то́кмо Ли́кѡвъ. Тѵпі́къ Царьгра́д. полага́етъ то́кмо на а҃-й Статі́й, сѐ же то́кмо Плащани́ци, и҆ людїй: Ὁ Πατριάρχης... θυμιάζων τὸν Ἐπιτάφιον, καὶ τὸν λαὸν ἅπαντα.
units.english_cohort_translation: And the Entrance takes place thus: During the chanting of the Stichera of the Praises, the Priest and Deacons, if there be any, having bowed deeply before the Plashchanytsia, together with the Holy Mysteries, go to the vestry and vest in all the sacred vestments of their Order. While the Doxastikon (*Naslavnyk*) is being sung, likewise the other sacred ministers who are before the Lord's Tomb, vested in phelonia, having bowed together deeply, depart into the Sanctuary; and the Priest with the Deacons having come before the steps of the Altar, they also stand together with him on this side and that; and all having bowed down toward the Holy Mysteries, the Priest proclaims after the chanting of the Stichera of the Praises: **"Glory to Thee Who hast shown us the light"** (*Сла́ва Тебѣ̀ показа́вшему на́мъ свѣ́тъ*); then, having placed incense for the Deacon on the left, as the Doxology is ending he ascends to the Altar, and having taken the Gospel from the Holy Table, hands it to the Deacon on the right, and they make the Entrance in all things as takes place at the Liturgy, preceded by the candle-bearers, and the Deacon with the censer; and they halt before the Lord's Tomb, the Deacon on the right at the right hand, and the one on the left at the left hand of the Priest, closer to the Tomb, while the other sacred ministers are on two wings, a little lower, with the Priest, awaiting the end of the Trisagion and the Sticheron **"Come, let us bless Joseph"** (*Прїиди́те, оу҆блажи́мъ Іѡ́сифа*). When this has taken place, the first Deacon, raising his orarion toward the people, proclaims: **"Let us attend!"** (*Во́ньмемъ*); the Priest, signing the people: **"Peace be to all"** (*Ми́ръ всѣ̑мъ*); the second Deacon, raising his orarion: **"Wisdom, let us attend!"** (*Премꙋ́дрость, во́ньмемъ*); and we sing the Troparion **"The noble Joseph"** (*Благообра́зный Іѡ́сифъ*) once. The Deacon having placed the Gospel upon the Analogion facing the people, and the other having handed over the censer, we sing also the Troparion of the Prophecy once.[^611]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Та́же па́ки: Во́ньмѣмъ, Ми́ръ всѣ̑мъ, Премꙋ́дрость во́ньмѣмъ, и҆ Прокі́менъ, и҆ Чте́нїе Проро́чества, и҆ дрꙋгі́й Прокі́менъ, и҆ Чте́нїе А҆пⷭ҇ла, и҆ А҆ллилꙋ́їа, на не́мже кадя́тъ Дїа́кони Гро́бъ и҆ предстоя́щїя Священнослꙋжи́тели, и҆ лю́ди. По си́хъ Дїа́конъ пе́рвый: Премꙋ́- ---------------- Премꙋ́дрость про́сти предъ Бл҃гообра́зный, а҆ предъ Тропаре́мъ Проро́чества: Во́ньмѣмъ, Ми́ръ тѝ, Премꙋ́дрость во́ньмѣмъ. — Вхо́дъ по Оу҆ста́вꙋ Россїйскомꙋ быва́етъ си́це: „Та́же вхо́дитъ настоя́тель во Ст҃ы́й О҆лта́рь со І҆ере́и и҆ Дїа́коны, и҆ ѡ҆блачи́тся во вся̑ сщ҃е́нныя ѡ҆де́жды, І҆ере́и же то́кмо въ ри́зы: и҆схо́дитъ со Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїемъ подъ Плащани́цею, наддержа́щимъ Свяще́нникѡмъ, Дїа́конѡмъ же кадя́щимъ. Въ то̀ вре́мя зво́нъ во вся̑, предходя́щимъ є҆мꙋ̀ со свѣща́ми, и҆ со двѣма̀ лампа́дома, и҆ ѻ҆́ба Ли́ка пою́ще Трист҃о́е надгро́бное. Прихо́дитъ же И҆гꙋ́менъ предъ Ст҃ы̑я Ца́рьскїя Две́ри, и҆ тꙋ̀ стои́тъ ѡ҆жида́я конца̀ Трист҃а́гѡ послѣ́днягѡ. Семꙋ́ же конча́нꙋ бы́вшꙋ, вхо́дитъ Настоя́тель со Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїемъ къ Црⷭ҇скїя Две́ри. и҆ полага́етъ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе на Престо́лѣ, Плащани́цꙋ же на оу҆гото́ванѣ столѣ̀, во Ѻ҆́бразъ Гро́ба. По Ѿпꙋ́стѣ быва́етъ цѣлова́нїе во Ѻ҆би́телехъ на Плащани́цѣ положе́нїя во Гро́бѣ. Тѵпі́кз Моск. Въ Патрїархі́и же Царьгра́д. быва́етъ си́це: Δοξολογία Μ. Εἶτα ἀρχόμεθα τοῦ Ἀσματικοῦ, προπορευόμενοι ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Ἐπιταφίου, καὶ ἐξερχόμενοι τοῦ Ναοῦ, γίνεται ἡ Εἴξοδος, ὡς εἴθισται; ἐπειδὰν δ’ ἐπανέλθωμεν, εἰσέρχεται ὁ Πατριάρχης κατ’ εὐθεῖαν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν Βῆμα, μετὰ τῶν λοιπῶν, καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκφωνεῖ· Πρόσχωμεν. Εἰρήνη πᾶσι. Σοφία· καὶ ψάλ. τὸ Τроπάριον Ὅτε κατῆλθες πρὸς τὸν θάνατον, καὶ ἐν τῷ ψάλ. θυμιᾷ κύκλῳ τὴν ἁγίαν Τράπεζαν, προπορευομένου ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Ἐπιταφίου, εἶτα ταῖς Μυροφόροις Γυναιξὶ, μέχρι τοῦ ἐδείχθη ἀλλότριος· ἑπομένως ψάλ. Ὁ εὐσχήμων Ἰωσὴφ, μέχρι τοῦ, κηδεύσας ἀπέθετο· καὶ τιθέασι τὸν Ἐπιτάφιον ἐπὶ τῆς ἁγίας Τραπέζης. ἅμα ὁ Κανονάρχης ἔξωθεν ἀναγινώσκει τὸ Τроπάριον, τὴν Προφητείαν, καὶ τὸν Ἀπόστολον, τὸ δὲ ἅγ. Εὐαγγέλ. λέγεται παρὰ τοῦ Πατριάρχου, ἔμπροσθεν τῆς Πύλης. (Но́в. Тѵп. Царьгра́д). Въ разли́чныхъ страна́хъ Гре́цїи, по свидѣ́тельствꙋ И҆лла́тїя, Похо́дъ быва́етъ си́це: Mos obtinuit, ut, dum Psalm. 118 canitur, et singulis versiculis singula Troparia concinuntur, Christus decore exsculptus, vel affabre in tabula depictus, et in feretro depositus, solemni cereorum ardentium apparatu, Sacerdotibus, quemadmodum, quum sacra Missarum solemnia celebrant, vestitis, reliquo Clero non sine ordine comitante, et Christi fidelibus feretrum prosequentibus per urbis plateas deferatur, proponaturque omnibus adorandus, atque exosculandus: sicque omnium venerationi patet. Interim flores imagini superpositi, maximo studio ab omnibus conquiruntur, quibus sibi maximo bono, non corporis modo, sed rerum etiam domesticarum pollicentur. (Nill. Kalend. t. 2. p. 241)

units.slavonic_text: Та́же па́ки: Во́ньмѣмъ, Ми́ръ всѣ̑мъ, Премꙋ́дрость во́ньмѣмъ, и҆ Прокі́менъ, и҆ Чте́нїе Проро́чества, и҆ дрꙋгі́й Прокі́менъ, и҆ Чте́нїе А҆пⷭ҇ла, и҆ А҆ллилꙋ́їа, на не́мже кадя́тъ Дїа́кони Гро́бъ и҆ предстоя́щїя Священнослꙋжи́тели, и҆ лю́ди. По си́хъ Дїа́конъ пе́рвый: Премꙋ́- ---------------- Премꙋ́дрость про́сти предъ Бл҃гообра́зный, а҆ предъ Тропаре́мъ Проро́чества: Во́ньмѣмъ, Ми́ръ тѝ, Премꙋ́дрость во́ньмѣмъ. — Вхо́дъ по Оу҆ста́вꙋ Россїйскомꙋ быва́етъ си́це: „Та́же вхо́дитъ настоя́тель во Ст҃ы́й О҆лта́рь со І҆ере́и и҆ Дїа́коны, и҆ ѡ҆блачи́тся во вся̑ сщ҃е́нныя ѡ҆де́жды, І҆ере́и же то́кмо въ ри́зы: и҆схо́дитъ со Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїемъ подъ Плащани́цею, наддержа́щимъ Свяще́нникѡмъ, Дїа́конѡмъ же кадя́щимъ. Въ то̀ вре́мя зво́нъ во вся̑, предходя́щимъ є҆мꙋ̀ со свѣща́ми, и҆ со двѣма̀ лампа́дома, и҆ ѻ҆́ба Ли́ка пою́ще Трист҃о́е надгро́бное. Прихо́дитъ же И҆гꙋ́менъ предъ Ст҃ы̑я Ца́рьскїя Две́ри, и҆ тꙋ̀ стои́тъ ѡ҆жида́я конца̀ Трист҃а́гѡ послѣ́днягѡ. Семꙋ́ же конча́нꙋ бы́вшꙋ, вхо́дитъ Настоя́тель со Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїемъ къ Црⷭ҇скїя Две́ри. и҆ полага́етъ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе на Престо́лѣ, Плащани́цꙋ же на оу҆гото́ванѣ столѣ̀, во Ѻ҆́бразъ Гро́ба. По Ѿпꙋ́стѣ быва́етъ цѣлова́нїе во Ѻ҆би́телехъ на Плащани́цѣ положе́нїя во Гро́бѣ. Тѵпі́кз Моск. Въ Патрїархі́и же Царьгра́д. быва́етъ си́це: Δοξολογία Μ. Εἶτα ἀρχόμεθα τοῦ Ἀσματικοῦ, προπορευόμενοι ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Ἐπιταφίου, καὶ ἐξερχόμενοι τοῦ Ναοῦ, γίνεται ἡ Εἴξοδος, ὡς εἴθισται; ἐπειδὰν δ’ ἐπανέλθωμεν, εἰσέρχεται ὁ Πατριάρχης κατ’ εὐθεῖαν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν Βῆμα, μετὰ τῶν λοιπῶν, καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκφωνεῖ· Πρόσχωμεν. Εἰρήνη πᾶσι. Σοφία· καὶ ψάλ. τὸ Τроπάριον Ὅτε κατῆλθες πρὸς τὸν θάνατον, καὶ ἐν τῷ ψάλ. θυμιᾷ κύκλῳ τὴν ἁγίαν Τράπεζαν, προπορευομένου ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Ἐπιταφίου, εἶτα ταῖς Μυροφόροις Γυναιξὶ, μέχρι τοῦ ἐδείχθη ἀλλότριος· ἑπομένως ψάλ. Ὁ εὐσχήμων Ἰωσὴφ, μέχρι τοῦ, κηδεύσας ἀπέθετο· καὶ τιθέασι τὸν Ἐπιτάφιον ἐπὶ τῆς ἁγίας Τραπέζης. ἅμα ὁ Κανονάρχης ἔξωθεν ἀναγινώσκει τὸ Τроπάριον, τὴν Προφητείαν, καὶ τὸν Ἀπόστολον, τὸ δὲ ἅγ. Εὐαγγέλ. λέγεται παρὰ τοῦ Πατριάρχου, ἔμπροσθεν τῆς Πύλης. (Но́в. Тѵп. Царьгра́д). Въ разли́чныхъ страна́хъ Гре́цїи, по свидѣ́тельствꙋ И҆лла́тїя, Похо́дъ быва́етъ си́це: Mos obtinuit, ut, dum Psalm. 118 canitur, et singulis versiculis singula Troparia concinuntur, Christus decore exsculptus, vel affabre in tabula depictus, et in feretro depositus, solemni cereorum ardentium apparatu, Sacerdotibus, quemadmodum, quum sacra Missarum solemnia celebrant, vestitis, reliquo Clero non sine ordine comitante, et Christi fidelibus feretrum prosequentibus per urbis plateas deferatur, proponaturque omnibus adorandus, atque exosculandus: sicque omnium venerationi patet. Interim flores imagini superpositi, maximo studio ab omnibus conquiruntur, quibus sibi maximo bono, non corporis modo, sed rerum etiam domesticarum pollicentur. (Nill. Kalend. t. 2. p. 241)

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4. А҆́ще и҆ Слꙋ́жба Пра́здника ѻ҆бы́чнѡ начина́ется съ Вече́рнею днѐ предидꙋ́щагѡ, и҆ сегѡ̀ ра́ди и҆мѣ́лабы бы́ти вся̑ Слꙋ́жба Воскре́сна съ сщ҃е́нными ѡ҆де́ждами свѣ́тлыми, ѻ҆ба́че поне́же Лїтꙋргі́а, съ не́юже пое́тся Вече́рна, є҆́сть є҆щѐ днѐ Сꙋббѡ́тнагѡ, сегѡ̀ ра́ди ча́сть Стїхи́ръ пое́мыхъ на Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ є҆́сть ѡ҆ снисше́ствїи дꙋшѝ Спаси́теля во а҆́дъ, и҆ сегѡ̀ ра́ди ѿ нача́ла Вече́рни сея̀ взе́млемъ ѡ҆де́жды вїѡлето́выя, по́слѣ же и҆змѣня́емъ я҃, и҆ взе́млемъ Свѣ́тлыя по ѿчте́нїи А҆пⷭ҇ла, на стїсѣ́хъ мѣстоаллилꙋ́евыхъ, да Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе чте́мъ оу҆жѐ во свѣ́тлыхъ.²)
units.english_cohort_translation: 3. The form and Typikon of this Vespers is the same as that of the Vespers with the Liturgy celebrated on the Paramony of the Nativity of Christ, here on p. 189, without **"Blessed is the man"** (*Блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ*); only here after **"O Joyful Light"** (*Свѣ́те ти́хїй*) there shall be no Prokeimenon, but immediately the Readings, 15 in number, and between the Readings there shall be no Troparia; but at the 6th Reading all the Verses of the Canticle of Moses are read with the refrain: **"For gloriously is He glorified"** (*Сла́вно бо просла́вися*); and at the 15th Reading the Verses of the Canticle of the Three Youths are read with the refrain: **"Praise the Lord and exalt Him above all forever"** (*Го́спода по́йте, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки*); and instead of Alleluia we sing the last verse of Psalm 81 with the other Verses thereof, in the manner of a Prokeimenon.[^613] Dismissal of Saturday Matins.

units.slavonic_incipit: ²) Си́це по Оу҆ста́вꙋ Трїѡ́дїй на́шихъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: сице по оуставу триодий наших и российских
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ²) Си́це по Оу҆ста́вꙋ Трїѡ́дїй на́шихъ и҆ Россїйскихъ; подо́бнѣ и҆ Тѵпі́къ Гре́ч. Са́ввинъ, то́кмо въ мѣ́стѡ вїѡлето́выхъ полага́етъ ѡ҆де́жды те́мныя: Μέλλοντος δὲ τοῦ Ψάλτου ἄρξασθαι τοῦ παρόντος στίχου, τοῦ Ἀνάστα ὁ Θεὸς, ἀνιστάμενοι οἱ Ἱερεῖς, ἀποδύονται τὰ μαυρὰ φελώνια, καὶ περιβάλλονται ἀνθ’ αὐτῶν λευκὰ. По Трїѡ́ди же Гре́честѣй, по Ѻ҆́кꙋ Церко́вномꙋ, и҆ и҆ны́мъ рꙋкопи́снымъ Оу҆ста́вѡмъ 5.
units.english_cohort_translation: 4. Although the Service of a Feast usually begins with the Vespers of the preceding day, and for this reason the entire Resurrection Service ought to be with bright sacred vestments, nevertheless, because the Liturgy with which Vespers is sung is still of Saturday, for this reason a portion of the Stichera sung at **"Lord, I have cried"** is concerning the descent of the Saviour's soul into Hades; and for this reason from the beginning of this Vespers we take violet vestments, but later we change them and take bright ones after the reading of the Apostle, at the verses replacing the Alleluia, so that we may read the Gospel already in bright vestments.[^614]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: в триодех греч и славяньских разве наших повечерие
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ Трїѡ́дехъ Гре́ч. и҆ Славя́ньскихъ, ра́звѣ на́шихъ, Повече́рїе не полага́ется, но ѿ Бл҃гослове́нїя Хлѣ́бѡвъ да́же до Послѣ́дованїя Надгро́бнагѡ, пое́магѡ безпосре́днѡ предъ Оу҆́тренею Па́схи, полага́етсѧ чте́нїе всея̀ Кни́ги Дѣя́нїй А҆пⷭ҇лскихъ, а҃ще и҆ оу҆ на́съ дне́сь є҆два̀ въ Хра́мѣхъ Престо́льныхъ, и҆ Сѣ́менищныхъ Дѣя́нїа сїя̑ пою́тся; пою́тся же на стїхѝ ѿ Кли́рїкѡвъ и҆змѣня́емыхъ по два̀.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: вечерие си имелобы быти малое в прочем и
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Повече́рїе сїѐ и҆мѣ́лобы бы́ти ма́лое. Въ про́чемъ, и҆ са́мая на́ша Трїѡ́дь ѡ҆ставля́етъ призволе́нїю честѝ є҆̀ и҆лѝ нѝ; глаго́летъ бо ѡ҆ не́мъ: а҃ще бꙋ́детъ. На слꙋча́й, полага́ется въ Трїѡ́ди на́шей Канѡ́нъ на Погребе́нїе Хрⷭ҇то́во, и҆ на пла́чь П. Б. По ѳ҃-й Пѣ́сни въ мѣ́стѡ Досто́йна І҆рмо́съ сея̀ Пѣ́сни; и҆ по Трист҃о́мъ Конда́къ Сꙋббѡ́ты вел.
units.english_cohort_translation: This Compline would have to be small. For the rest, even our Triodion itself leaves to discretion whether to read it or not; for it says concerning it: "if it be." After the 9th Ode, instead of **"It is truly right"**, the Heirmos of this Ode; and after the Trisagion, the Kontakion of Great Saturday.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 4 таже к конец блгообразный иосиф г жды с
units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4. Та́же къ коне́цъ: Бл҃гообра́зный І҆ѡ́сифъ г҃-жды съ покло́ны, я҃кѡже по Оу҆́трени Сꙋббѡ́ты вели́кїя; ѻ҆ба́че Плащани́цꙋ лобиза́ютъ то́кмо Священнослꙋжи́телїе, по чи́нꙋ; и҆ сне́мъ И҆рхїере́й Плащани́цꙋ ѿ Гро́ба, врꙋча́етъ ю҆ четы́ремъ Клироша́нѡмъ, и҆ си́це возвраща́ются всѝ Священнослꙋжи́телїе въ О҆лта́рь; и҆ завѣ́сившимъ четы́ремъ Клироша́нѡмъ Плащани́цꙋ за ст҃о́ю Трапе́зою на́дъ Го́рнимъ Сѣда́лищемъ,²) и҆́дꙋтъ въ Сосꙋдохрани́льницꙋ, и҆ и҆звле́кшеся ѿ ѡ҆де́ждъ вїѡлето́выхъ, ѡ҆блека́ются во вся̑ сщ҃е́нныя своегѡ̀ Чи́на ѡ҆де́жды свѣ́тлыя, и҆ въ то̀ вре́мя вжига́ются вся̑ свѣщѝ, я҃же въ Це́ркви.
units.english_cohort_translation: 5. [4 in original] Then toward the end: **"The noble Joseph"** (*Благообра́зный Іѡ́сифъ*) thrice with prostrations, as after Great Saturday Matins; however, the Plashchanytsia is kissed only by the sacred ministers, according to rank; and the Hierarch, having taken the Plashchanytsia from the Tomb, delivers it to four Choir-clerics, and thus all the sacred ministers return into the Sanctuary; and four Choir-clerics having hung the Plashchanytsia behind the Holy Table above the High Place,[^617] they go to the vestry, and having divested themselves of the violet vestments, vest in all the bright sacred vestments of their Order; and at that time all the candles in the church are lit.

units.slavonic_incipit: Ѡ҆ вре́мени и҆ мѣ́стѣ положе́нїя Плащани́ци
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: о времени и месте положения плащаници оустава древнаго
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆ вре́мени и҆ мѣ́стѣ положе́нїя Плащани́ци Оу҆ста́ва дре́внагѡ не ѡ҆брѣта́емъ; є҆́сть бо се́й ѻ҆бря́дъ по́зднѣйшїй, и҆ разли́чний по разли́чїю стра́нъ. По ѻ҆бы́чаю Це́ркве на́шея Первопресто́лныя, Плащани́ца пребыва́етъ завѣ́шена за С. Трапе́зою на́дъ Го́рнимъ Сѣда́лищемъ ѿ Оу҆́трени Па́схи да́же до Ѿда́нїя Па́схи вклю́чнѡ, си́рѣчь до Среды̀ предъ Вознесе́нїемъ. По ѻ҆бы́чаю и҆ны́хъ на́шихъ Церкве́й, Плащани́ца сня́та ѿ Гро́ба пре́жде Оу҆́трени Па́схи полага́ется на С. units.slavonic_diplomatic: По сня́тїи Плащани́ци ѿ Гро́ба, и҆ внесе́нїи въ О҆лта́рь, Священнослꙋжи́телїе, ѡ҆бле́кшеся во вся̑ сщ҃е́нныя ѡ҆де́жды свѣ́тлѣйшїя своегѡ̀ Чи́на, и҆схо́дятъ предъ Степе́ни О҆лтаря̀, и҆ покло́ньшеся всѝ ра́внѡ и҆ глубо́кѡ къ Ст҃ы́мъ Та́йнамъ, приклоня́ютъ колѣ́нѣ, и҆ прїе́млютъ возже́нныя свѣ́щи; та́кѡжде и҆ Бра́тство на Це́ркви. Дїа́конъ же десны́й (и҆лѝ са́мъ І҆ере́й, а҃ще Дїа́конѡвъ нѣ́сть), пристꙋ́пль къ среди́нкѣ Ст҃ыя Трапе́зы, и҆ покло́нься глубо́кѡ, ѿлага́етъ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе на деснꙋ́ю страну̀ є҆я̀, и҆ сне́мъ ---------------- ¹) Си́це быва́етъ въ Россїи, по свидѣ́тельствꙋ Мѡ́ралта, Посла́н. 14: um die h. Tafel herum, auf welchem das Leichentuch ausgebreitet ist, das hier bleibt bis zum Tage der Himmelfahrt.
units.english_cohort_translation: After the taking of the Plashchanytsia from the Tomb and carrying it into the Sanctuary, the sacred ministers, having vested in all the brightest sacred vestments of their Order, go out before the steps of the Altar, and having all bowed equally and deeply toward the Holy Mysteries, bend their knees, and take lighted candles; likewise also the Brotherhood in the church. The Deacon on the right (or the Priest himself, if there be no Deacons), having approached the middle of the Holy Table and bowed deeply, sets aside the Gospel on the right side thereof, and having taken the Holy Mysteries from the top of the Tabernacle (*Skynia*), and having placed them upon the Iliton, steps back a little to the side; and the Hierarch (or presiding Priest), having censed the Holy Mysteries thrice according to custom, and put on the Omophorion, standing up and ascending the steps, and having bowed down, receives the Holy Mysteries from the hands of the Deacon, turns toward the people, and when he begins to sing the Sticheron **"Jesus is risen from the tomb"** (*Воскре́съ І҆исꙋ́съ ѿ гро́ба*), while all the bells chime joyfully, the Procession around the church takes place, in all respects as was depicted on Great Friday at Vespers, here on page 445, except for the Plashchanytsia, which here, by order of Cardinal Sembratovych of blessed memory, is not to be carried, because it does not agree with the joy of the Resurrection; rather, it is fitting to carry the Icon of the Resurrection, as the Triodion has it at the beginning of Paschal Matins during the Procession to the church doors. And when the Superior begins to sing the Sticheron **"Jesus is risen from the tomb"**, the Choirs and the people follow in singing the same, and they sing it, repeating it until the Procession is completed, that is, a threefold, or at least a single circuit around the church, which when it is completed, all enter into the church, while the banner-bearers and icon-bearers remain before the church doors to avoid commotion during the second Procession; while in the church the cross-bearer with two candle-bearers, the Brotherhood, the Choirs, and the Clergy arrange themselves for the Procession; and when the sacred ministers have entered into the Sanctuary, the Superior ascends the Altar, and having turned toward the people, blesses them with the Holy Mysteries, saying in a gentle voice: **"Save, O God, Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance"** (*Спасѝ, Бо́же, лю́ди Твоя̀, и҆ благословѝ достоя́нїе Твоѐ*); and having set down the Holy Mysteries upon the Altar, he descends before the steps, bends his knees, and having laid aside the Omophorion, censes the Holy Mysteries thrice according to custom; and the Deacon, having approached the Holy Mysteries and bowed deeply, removes them with the lunette from the Monstrance (*Darookazalnytsia*), and places them into the Tabernacle (*Kivot*),

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Примѣча́нїе: Похо́дъ се́й со Ст҃ы́ми Та́йнами пре́жде Оу҆́трени Па́схи є҆́сть позднѣ́йшею прина́дою на́шихъ Церкве́й, заи́мствованою ни ѿ Гре́кѡвъ, ни ѿ Ри́млянъ, но ѿ Церкве́й Лати́нскихъ си́хъ Стра́нъ, и҆ и҆зли́шнею великолѣ́пїю Оу҆́тренни на́шея Пасха́лныя; нижѐ въ Оу҆ста́вѣхъ на́шихъ полага́ется.
units.english_cohort_translation: *Note.* This Procession with the Holy Mysteries before Paschal Matins is a later adornment of our Churches, borrowed neither from the Greeks nor from the Romans, but from the Latin Churches of these regions, and an added magnificence to our Paschal Matins; nor is it set down in our Typika.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1. Похо́дъ предъ две́ри Церко́вныя. И҆сходя́щимъ всѣ̑мъ лю́демъ ѿ Це́ркве, и҆схо́дятъ за ни́ми та́кѡжде и҆ Сщ҃еннослꙋжи́телїе, и҆ быва́етъ Похо́дъ си́це: Ста́вшимъ Сщ҃еннослꙋжи́телемъ, во всѣ́хъ си сщ҃е́нныхъ ѡ҆де́ждахъ свѣ́тлыхъ, предъ степе́ньми Ст҃ы́я Трапе́зы, Нача́льствꙋющїй прїе́млетъ Кре́стъ, Дїа́конъ же Кади́льницꙋ, и҆ покло́ньшимся всѣ̑мъ ра́внѡ и҆ глубо́кѡ къ Ст҃ы́мъ Та́йнамъ, и҆ ѡ҆бра́щшимся на за́падъ, начина́етъ Нача́льствꙋющїй пѣ́ти Стїхи́рꙋ Воскресе́нїе твоѐ Хрїстѐ Спа́се; и҆ всѣ̑мъ послѣ́дꙋющимъ пѣ́ти тꙋ́юже, и҆схо́дятъ ѿ Святи́лища, І҆ере́е оу҆́бо Ца́рьскими, про́чїи же Сщ҃еннослꙋжи́телїе Дїа́конскими Две́рми на Це́рковь, и҆ звоня́щимъ всѣ̑мъ клако́лѡмъ, и҆́дꙋтъ да́же до Двере́й вели́кихъ Церко́вныхъ, и҆ и҆сше́дше внѣ̀ Це́ркве, ста́нꙋтъ чи́ннѡ, лице́мъ проти́вꙋ двере́мъ Церко́внымъ, я҃же и҆ а҆́бїе затворя́ются.¹) И҆ вну́трь Це́ркве оу҆́бо полага́ются на ---------------- ¹) По Оу҆ста́вꙋ дре́внемъ Ѻ҆бщежи́тельствъ Похо́дъ се́й соверша́шеся и҆зъ Хра́ма въ Притво́ръ чрезъ Две́ри сѣ́верныя то́гѡже Притво́ра и҆ та́мо предъ Две́рми сре́дными є҆гѡ̀ въводя́щими во Хра́мъ поя́шеся нача́ло Оу҆́треня Па́схи. 461 Ст҃ѣ́й Трапе́зѣ, во пе́рвыхъ І҆ко́на Воск. Хрⷭ҇то́ва, ѡ҆бы́чнѡ верхꙋ̀ А҆́ртоса, и҆ и҆ны́я честны̑я І҆ко́ны, и҆ Мощехрани́льници, и҆ драгоцѣннѣ́йшая Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїа, и҆лѝ что̀ и҆́но ѿ сщ҃е́нныхъ веще́й, вся̑ сїя̑ по числꙋ̀ І҆ере́евъ, хотя́щихъ я҃ да́ти къ цѣлова́нїю лю́демъ при концѝ Оу҆́трени; внѣ̀ же предъ две́рьми Церко́вными быва́етъ нача́ло Оу҆́трени си́це.¹) 2. Нача́ло Оу҆́трени. А҆́бїе по затворе́нїи двере́й Церко́вныхъ І҆ере́й нача́льствꙋющїй, держа̀ въ лѣ́вой рꙋцѣ̀ кре́стъ, въ десно́й же Кади́льницꙋ, и҆ кадя̀ две́ри Церко́вныя,²) возглаша́етъ велегла́снѡ: Сла́ва ст҃ѣ́й, и҆ прѡ́ч.
units.english_cohort_translation: 1. **Procession Before the Church Doors.** As all the people go out from the church, the sacred ministers likewise go out after them, and the Procession takes place thus: when the sacred ministers have taken their stand, in all their bright sacred vestments, before the steps of the Holy Table, the Superior takes the Cross, and the Deacon the Censer; and when all have bowed equally and deeply toward the Holy Mysteries and turned toward the west, the Superior begins to sing the Sticheron **"Thy Resurrection, O Christ Savior"** (*Воскресе́нїе Твоѐ, Христѐ Спа́се*); and while all follow in singing the same, they go out from the Sanctuary, the Priests indeed through the Royal Doors, and the other sacred ministers through the Deacon's Doors into the church, and while all the bells are ringing, they go even unto the great Church Doors; and having gone outside the church, they stand orderly, facing the church doors, which are immediately closed.[^619] And inside the church there are placed upon the Holy Table, first of all the Icon of the Resurrection of Christ, usually upon the Artos, and other venerable Icons, and Reliquaries, and the most precious Gospels, or whatever else of sacred things, all these according to the number of Priests who intend to give them to the people to kiss at the end of Matins; while outside before the church doors the beginning of Matins takes place thus.[^620]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ²) Оу҆ста́ви Славя́нстїи повелѣва́ютъ пре́жде сегѡ̀ кади́ти всѣ́хъ, мы́ же по Оу҆ста́вꙋ Гре́ч. кади́мъ, здѣ̀ то́кмо пря́мо вра́тъ Церк. units.slavonic_incipit: Оу҆́трени Пасха́льной чрезъ всю̀ Седми́цꙋ Свѣ́тлꙋ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: оутрени пасхальной чрез всю седмицу светлу не глаголются
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆́трени Пасха́льной чрезъ всю̀ Седми́цꙋ Свѣ́тлꙋ не глаго́лются, и҆́бо сїя̑ привя́заны сꙋ́ть до Шестоѱа́лмїя, є҆мꙋ́же здѣ̀ оу҆стꙋпа́ющꙋ, оу҆стꙋпа́ютъ и҆ Мл҃итвы. А҆́ще бы и҆мѣ́лися глаго́лати и҆ Мл҃итвы, Оу҆ста́въ до́лженъ бы оу҆каза́ти, гдѣ̀ ты́я глаго́лати, и҆́бо во вре́мя Стїхѡ́въ Да воскре́снетъ Бг҃ъ, занима́ющихъ мѣ́сто Шестоѱа́лмїя, глаго́латися не могꙋ́тъ, въ то́ бо вре́мя Оу҆ста́въ повелѣва́етъ І҆ере́еви глаго́лати стїхѝ, а҆ не прилага́ти є҆щѐ и҆ Мл҃итвы.
units.english_cohort_translation: Paschal Matins throughout all of Bright Week are not said, because these are linked to the Six Psalms, and since the latter here give way, the Prayers also give way. If the Prayers were to be said, the Typikon would have had to indicate where to say them, for during the Verses **"Let God arise"**, which occupy the place of the Six Psalms, they cannot be said, for at that time the Typikon commands the Priest to pronounce the verses, and not to add the Prayers besides.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3. Вхо́дъ въ Це́рковь. Вхо́дъ Похо́да въ Це́рковь соверша́ется проти́внымъ ѻ҆́бразомъ ѿ ѻ҆́нагѡ и҆́мже и҆схожда́ше ѿ Це́ркве, си́рѣчь пре́жде вхо́дитъ Нача́льствꙋющїй, та́же про́чїи І҆ере́е, и҆ Сщ҃еннослꙋжи́телїе, и҆ ве́сь Кли́ръ, та́же Пѣвцы̀, и҆ Бра́тство, и҆ Хорꙋ́гво- и҆ І҆кононо́сци, и҆ Крестоно́сецъ, и҆ всѝ лю́дїе. И҆ І҆ере́е оу҆́бо вхо́дятъ въ О҆лта́рь, и҆ пристꙋпа́ютъ къ Ст҃ѣ́й Трапе́зѣ, И҆рхїере́й же а҃́ще бꙋ́детъ, восхо́дитъ на сво́й Престо́лъ; Дїа́конъ же ста́нетъ на свое́мъ си мѣ́стѣ предъ Ца́рскими Браты̀, да пое́тъ ѿ та́мꙋ Є҆кте́нїю.
units.english_cohort_translation: 3. **Entrance into the Church.** The Entrance of the Procession into the church is made in the reverse order from that in which it went out from the church, that is, first the Superior enters, then the other Priests and sacred ministers, and the entire Clergy, then the Chanters, the Brotherhood, the banner-bearers and icon-bearers, the cross-bearer, and all the people. And the Priests indeed enter into the Sanctuary and approach the Holy Table, while the Hierarch, if there be one, ascends his Throne; and the Deacon takes his stand at his place before the Royal Doors, that he may sing the Ektenia from there.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 5. Канѡ́нъ Па́схи: І҆рмосѝ по д҃-жды (въ Гре́ческихъ по в҃-жды), Тропа́рїе же на в҃і. (Дне́сь І҆рмосѝ по а҃-жды, Тропа́рїе же съ І҆рмосо́мъ на д҃.). Катавасі́а по кое́йждо Пѣ́сни І҆рмо́съ Канѡ́на ѿ ѻ҆бо́ю Ли́кꙋ кꙋ́пнѡ ----------------
units.english_cohort_translation: 5. **The Paschal Canon:** Heirmoi 4 times (in the Greek 2 times), and Troparia for 12. (Today Heirmoi once, and Troparia with the Heirmos for 4). Katavasia after each Ode, the Heirmos of the Canon, by both Choirs together once. The Priest sings the Heirmoi, and the Choirs sing the Troparia and Katavasia. Refrain to the Troparia of the Canon: **"Christ is risen from the dead"** (*Христо́съ воскре́се и҆зъ ме́ртвыхъ*); at the penultimate, **"Glory"** (*Сла́ва*), and at the last, **"Both now"** (*И҆ ны́нѣ*), according to custom.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 7. Цѣлова́нїе дрꙋг̾дрꙋ́га. Сїѐ въ Оу҆ста́вѣхъ полага́ется на Хрⷭ҇то́съ воскре́се по ѡ҆конча́нїи послѣ́днїя Стїхи́ры Па́схи; ѻ҆ба́че дне́сь не цѣлꙋ́емъ дрꙋг̾дрꙋ́га, я҃кѡже и҆́мать Стїхи́ра, глаго́лющи: и҆ дрꙋг̾дрꙋ́га ѡ҆биме́мъ, но то́кмо Ч. Кре́стъ, Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе и҆ Ст҃ы́я І҆ко́ны держи́мыя ѿ І҆ере́евъ, привѣ́тствꙋющихъ коегѡ́ждо ѿ пристꙋпа́ющихъ словесы̀: Хрїсто́съ воскре́се, и҆ прїе́млющихъ ѿвѣ́тъ: Вои́стинꙋ воскре́се. Є҆щѐ же начина́емъ цѣлова́нїе не по Стїхи́рахъ Па́схи, но въ нача́лѣ и҆́хъ на Припѣ́вкѣ Да воскре́снетъ Бг҃ъ, за є҆́же мно́гимъ лю́демъ пристꙋпа́ти къ цѣлова́нїю. Є҆гда̀ же зѣлѡ̀ мно́зи пристꙋпа́ютъ, тогда̀ и҆ во вре́мя Канѡ́на быва́етъ цѣлова́нїе. Цѣлова́нїе же сїѐ по ѻ҆бы́чаю на́шемꙋ быва́етъ си́це: А҆́ще бꙋ́детъ є҆ди́нъ то́кмо І҆ере́й, се́й ста́въ въ Ца́рьскихъ Вратѣ́хъ, дае́тъ ѿтꙋ́дꙋ лю́демъ цѣлова́ти Кре́стъ, глаго́ля кое́мꙋждо: Хрїсто́съ воскре́се, и҆ ѿвѣща́етъ цѣлова́вый: Вои́стинꙋ воскре́се. А҆́ще же вя́щше бꙋ́детъ І҆ере́евъ, то̀ пре́жде Нача́льствꙋющїй, и҆зше́дъ съ Кресто́мъ въ рꙋцѣ̀ ѿ Ца́рьскихъ Бра́тъ, ста́вится предъ І҆коноста́сомъ ѿ страны̀ десны́я, си́рѣчь ѿ І҆ко́ны Спа́совыя, зря̀ на Сѣ́веръ; и҆ и҆зше́дъ за ни́мъ вторы́й І҆ере́й ѿ Цр҃скихъ Бра́тъ съ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїемъ, пристꙋпа́етъ къ немꙋ̀, се́й же подае́тъ є҆мꙋ̀ цѣлова́ти Кре́стъ, глаго́ля: Хрїсто́съ воскре́се, и҆ поцѣлова́вый дае́тъ є҆мꙋ̀ цѣлова́ти Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе, ѿвѣщава́я: Вои́стинꙋ воскре́се, и҆ ста́вится ѡ҆шꙋ́ю є҆гѡ̀; та́же и҆зше́дъ тре́тїй І҆ере́й съ І҆ко́ною Воскресе́нїя Хрⷭ҇то́ва, пристꙋпа́етъ къ пе́рвомꙋ, и҆́же дае́тъ є҆мꙋ̀ цѣлова́ти Кре́стъ, глаго́ля: Хрїсто́съ воскре́се, и҆ поцѣлова́вый дае́тъ є҆мꙋ̀ цѣлова́ти І҆ко́нꙋ Воскресе́нїя, ѿвѣщава́я: Вои́стинꙋ воскре́се; и҆ пристꙋпа́етъ къ І҆ере́ю второ́мꙋ, и҆́же подае́тъ є҆мꙋ̀ цѣлова́ти Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе, глаго́ля: Хрїсто́съ воскре́се, се́й же поцѣлова́въ Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе подае́тъ є҆мꙋ̀ цѣлова́ти І҆ко́нꙋ Воскресе́нїя, ѿвѣщава́я; Вои́стинꙋ воскре́се, и҆ 466 Оу҆́треня Па́схи.
units.english_cohort_translation: 7. **The Kiss of Peace.** This in the Typika is appointed at **"Christ is risen"** at the conclusion of the last Sticheron of Pascha; nevertheless, today we do not kiss one another, as the Sticheron has it, saying: **"and let us embrace one another"**, but only the Venerable Cross, the Gospel, and the Holy Icons held by the Priests, who greet each of those approaching with the words: **"Christ is risen"**, and receive the response: **"Truly He is risen"**. Furthermore, we begin the kiss not after the Paschal Stichera, but at their beginning at the Verse **"Let God arise"**, because of the many people approaching for the kiss. When very many approach, the kiss takes place even during the Canon. And this kiss according to our custom takes place thus: if there be only one Priest, he, standing in the Royal Doors, gives the Cross from there to the people to kiss, saying to each: **"Christ is risen"**, and the one kissing answers: **"Truly He is risen"**. If there be more Priests, first the Superior, having gone out with the Cross in his hand from the Royal Doors, stands before the Iconostasis on the right side, that is, by the Icon of the Savior, looking toward the north; and the second Priest, having gone out after him from the Royal Doors with the Gospel, approaches him, and the Superior gives him the Cross to kiss, saying: **"Christ is risen"**, and he having kissed it gives him the Gospel to kiss, answering: **"Truly He is risen"**, and takes his stand at his left hand; then the third Priest, having gone out with the Icon of the Resurrection of Christ, approaches the first, who gives him the Cross to kiss, saying: **"Christ is risen"**, and he having kissed it gives him the Icon of the Resurrection to kiss, answering: **"Truly He is risen"**; and he approaches the second Priest, who gives him the Gospel to kiss, saying: **"Christ is risen"**, and he having kissed the Gospel gives him the Icon of the Resurrection to kiss, answering: **"Truly He is risen"**, and takes his stand at the left hand of the second. And the fourth Priest, having gone out with the Icon of the Theotokos, approaches the first, then the second and the third, each of whom gives him his sacred object to kiss, saying: **"Christ is risen"**, and he having kissed it gives each of them the Icon of the Theotokos to kiss, answering: **"Truly He is risen"**; and in this manner do also the other Priests, as many as there be. In Cathedral Churches the Hierarch, sitting upon his Throne by the Icon of the Savior, gives the Cross to kiss, and likewise the Choir-clerics, each giving his sacred image to kiss, sitting upon the benches. When the kiss has been completed among the Priests, then the other sacred ministers and all the people approach one by one to each Priest according to rank, beginning from the first, and kiss his sacred emblem, answering: **"Truly He is risen"**.[^626] After the kiss there was sometimes read the Catechetical Homily of Chrysostom, which is in the Flowery Triodion.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1. Въ мѣ́сто Царю̀ небе́сный на Проскоми́дїи, и҆ на Лїтꙋргі́и, и҆ и҆́дѣже а҃́ще бꙋ́детъ, глаго́лемъ Хрїсто́съ воскре́се г҃. да́же до Вознесе́нїя; Ѿ Вознесе́нїя же д ---------------- ¹) Си́це на́ши Слꙋже́бници; въ Трїѡ́дехъ же на́шихъ и҆ Россїйскихъ въ мѣ́сто Честнѣ́йшꙋю не полага́ется Свѣти́ся, нижѐ въ мѣ́сто Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е оу҆пова́нїе на́ше: Хрїсто́съ воскре́се до сме́ртїю сме́рть попра́въ, съ Ѿвѣ́томъ: И҆ сꙋ́щымъ во гробѣ́хъ живо́тъ дарова́въ; Гре́честїи же Оу҆ста́ви ничто́же ѿ си́хъ и҆мѣ́ютъ нижѐ Ѿпꙋ́ста съ Кресто́мъ, Ѿпꙋ́стъ же полага́ютъ Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν. я҃кѡже въ Недѣ́лю. units.slavonic_diplomatic: По Бл҃гослове́нно Ца́рство пое́мъ Хрїсто́съ воскре́се г҃-жды; си́рѣчь І҆ере́й а҃-жды, и҆ ѻ҆́ба Ли́ка по а҃-жды; (А҆́ще и҆ Трїѡ́дь на́ша глаго́летъ: І҆ере́й г҃-жды, и҆ Ли́ки то́йже по г҃-жды.) а҆ и҆́дѣже то́кмо є҆ди́нъ Ли́къ, то̀ І҆ере́й а҃-жды, и҆ Ли́къ а҃-жды, та́же полови́нꙋ І҆ере́й, и҆ полови́нꙋ (Ѿ и҆ сꙋ́щымъ во гробѣ́хъ) Ли́къ.
units.english_cohort_translation: After **"Blessed is the Kingdom"** we sing **"Christ is risen"** thrice; that is, the Priest once, and both Choirs once each; (although our Triodion says: the Priest thrice, and the Choirs the same thrice each); and where there is only one Choir, the Priest once and the Choir once, then half by the Priest, and half (from **"and upon those in the tombs"**) by the Choir.
